articles.title: A rare disease reveals a hidden flaw in the immune system

paras.en: A rare disease reveals a hidden flaw in the immune system
paras.zh: 一种罕见疾病揭示了免疫系统中隐藏的缺陷

paras.en: - Scientists have discovered that a rare, potentially life-threatening inflammatory disorder is driven by malfunctioning immune cells, overturning three decades of scientific understanding. The breakthrough points to a promising new treatment using existing medications, with one severely affected infant already showing substantial improvement.
paras.zh: - 科学家发现，一种罕见的、可能危及生命的炎症性疾病是由免疫细胞功能失常引起的，颠覆了三十年来的科学认识。这一突破指出了一种使用现有药物的有希望的新疗法，一名严重受影响的婴儿已经表现出显着的改善。

paras.en: For decades, scientists believed they understood what caused the dangerous inflammation associated with a rare genetic disorder. Now, researchers at the Garvan Institute of Medical Research have uncovered evidence that challenges 30 years of established thinking and could open the door to a new treatment.
paras.zh: 几十年来，科学家们相信他们了解导致与罕见遗传性疾病相关的危险炎症的原因。现在，加文医学研究所的研究人员发现了挑战 30 年来既定思维的证据，并可能为新疗法打开大门。

paras.en: The condition, known as mevalonate kinase deficiency (MKD), can cause severe inflammatory episodes that are sometimes life-threatening. A new study published in Immunity identifies a previously underrecognized problem involving natural killer (NK) cells, immune cells that normally help the body eliminate infected cells.
paras.zh: 这种情况被称为甲羟戊酸激酶缺乏症（MKD），可引起严重的炎症发作，有时甚至危及生命。发表在《Immunity》上的一项新研究发现了一个以前未被充分认识的问题，涉及自然杀伤 (NK) 细胞，这种免疫细胞通常帮助身体消除受感染的细胞。

paras.en: The researchers found that these cells malfunction in people with MKD, setting off an excessive inflammatory response when infections occur. The discovery also points to a possible treatment using existing medications called JAK inhibitors, which could be particularly valuable for patients who do not respond to current therapies.
paras.zh: 研究人员发现，MKD 患者的这些细胞出现故障，当感染发生时会引发过度的炎症反应。这一发现还指出了一种可能的治疗方法，即使用称为 JAK 抑制剂的现有药物进行治疗，这对于对当前治疗没有反应的患者特别有价值。

paras.en: "This study has revealed a new target for this inflammatory disorder and sets the scene for future clinical studies to explore the use of JAK inhibitors or other drugs to neutralize interferon gamma in patients with MKD," says Professor Mike Rogers, Lab Head at Garvan and senior author of the study. "This could lead to a targeted treatment that hasn't been tried before."
paras.zh: Garvan 实验室负责人、该研究的资深作者 Mike Rogers 教授表示：“这项研究揭示了这种炎症性疾病的新靶标，并为未来的临床研究奠定了基础，探索使用 JAK 抑制剂或其他药物中和 MKD 患者的干扰素 γ。” “这可能会导致一种以前从未尝试过的有针对性的治疗。”

paras.en: Why a Rare Immune Disease Causes Dangerous Inflammation
paras.zh: 为什么罕见的免疫疾病会导致危险的炎症

paras.en: MKD is a lifelong condition known to affect hundreds of children and adults around the world, although researchers suspect that many people with the disorder have never been diagnosed. Patients experience recurring attacks of high fever, skin rashes, joint pain, and inflammation in the abdomen. The most serious episodes can cause potentially fatal complications.
paras.zh: MKD 是一种终生疾病，已知影响世界各地数百名儿童和成人，尽管研究人员怀疑许多患有这种疾病的人从未被诊断出来。患者会反复出现高烧、皮疹、关节疼痛和腹部炎症。最严重的发作可能会导致潜在致命的并发症。

paras.en: For roughly three decades, research into the disease has largely centered on macrophages, immune cells that help coordinate the body's inflammatory defenses. Existing treatments are designed to block an inflammatory signal released by these cells. However, approximately half of patients do not respond adequately, leaving a major need for better treatment options.
paras.zh: 大约三十年来，对该疾病的研究主要集中在巨噬细胞，即帮助协调人体炎症防御的免疫细胞。现有的治疗旨在阻止这些细胞释放的炎症信号。然而，大约一半的患者没有充分反应，因此迫切需要更好的治疗选择。

paras.en: To investigate what might be missing from the prevailing explanation, the Garvan team examined blood samples from people with MKD and studied preclinical models of the disorder.
paras.zh: 为了调查流行的解释中可能遗漏的内容，Garvan 团队检查了 MKD 患者的血液样本，并研究了该疾病的临床前模型。

paras.en: Their experiments revealed a significant defect in natural killer cells, which play an important role in the body's early defenses against viral infections. In MKD, these cells fail to mature properly and struggle to perform one of their most important functions: destroying infected cells before an infection can spread.
paras.zh: 他们的实验揭示了自然杀伤细胞的显着缺陷，而自然杀伤细胞在人体早期防御病毒感染方面发挥着重要作用。在 MKD 中，这些细胞无法正常成熟，并且难以执行其最重要的功能之一：在感染扩散之前摧毁受感染的细胞。

paras.en: The consequences go beyond an impaired ability to fight infection. When natural killer cells cannot eliminate their targets, they release large amounts of inflammatory signaling molecules, activating other parts of the immune system and potentially triggering widespread inflammation.
paras.zh: 其后果不仅仅是抵抗感染能力受损。当自然杀伤细胞无法消除其目标时，它们会释放大量炎症信号分子，激活免疫系统的其他部分，并可能引发广泛的炎症。

paras.en: "We found that these immune cells are essentially misfiring," explains Professor Rogers. "NK cells are loaded with toxic ammunition, stored in granules that are released to kill infected cells. However, in MKD these toxic granules can't be released from NK cells and remain trapped inside. When an NK cell fails to kill its target, it compensates by shouting for help, pumping out large amounts of interferon gamma - a powerful inflammatory signal. This activates other immune cells and causes the dangerous fever and widespread inflammation seen in patients."
paras.zh: “我们发现这些免疫细胞本质上是失火的，”罗杰斯教授解释道。 “NK 细胞装载有有毒弹药，储存在颗粒中，释放出来杀死受感染的细胞。然而，在 MKD 中，这些有毒颗粒无法从 NK 细胞中释放出来，而是被困在里面。当 NK 细胞未能杀死目标时，它会通过呼救、泵出大量干扰素 γ（一种强大的炎症信号）来进行补偿。这会激活其他免疫细胞，导致患者出现危险的发烧和广泛的炎症。”

paras.en: Discovery Challenges 30 Years of Immune Disease Research
paras.zh: 这一发现挑战了 30 年的免疫疾病研究

paras.en: The findings suggest that natural killer cell dysfunction, rather than macrophage activity alone, plays a central role in driving MKD.
paras.zh: 研究结果表明，自然杀伤细胞功能障碍，而不仅仅是巨噬细胞的活性，在驱动 MKD 中发挥着核心作用。

paras.en: Dr. Marcia Munoz, Group Leader in the Rogers Lab and lead researcher on the study, says the results represent a major change in how scientists understand the disease.
paras.zh: 罗杰斯实验室的小组组长兼该研究的首席研究员 Marcia Munoz 博士表示，这些结果代表了科学家们对这种疾病理解方式的重大变化。

paras.en: "This really turns on its head 30 years of dogma about what was thought to be the underlying mechanism of disease. In MKD, the primary problem is in NK cells and not in macrophages, as previously believed," she says.
paras.zh: “这确实颠覆了 30 年来关于疾病根本机制的教条。在 MKD 中，主要问题在于 NK 细胞，而不是之前认为的巨噬细胞，”她说。

paras.en: To investigate how this cellular defect contributes to the disorder, the Garvan researchers collaborated with Professor Mariapia Degli-Esposti and scientists at Monash University.
paras.zh: 为了研究这种细胞缺陷如何导致这种疾病，加文研究人员与莫纳什大学的 Mariapia Degli-Esposti 教授和科学家合作。

paras.en: Using preclinical models, the team established a connection between malfunctioning natural killer cells and the severe symptoms associated with MKD. Their experiments showed that when the immune system cannot clear a viral infection, the resulting inflammatory response can cause extensive damage to organs.
paras.zh: 利用临床前模型，研究小组建立了自然杀伤细胞故障与 MKD 相关严重症状之间的联系。他们的实验表明，当免疫系统无法清除病毒感染时，产生的炎症反应会对器官造成广泛损害。

paras.en: These results help explain why a disorder involving defective immune defenses can also produce episodes of extreme inflammation.
paras.zh: 这些结果有助于解释为什么涉及免疫防御缺陷的疾病也会产生严重炎症。

paras.en: Existing Drug Shows Promise for a New Treatment
paras.zh: 现有药物显示出新疗法的前景

paras.en: The discovery has already helped guide an experimental treatment approach for a severely affected infant.
paras.zh: 这一发现已经帮助指导了针对严重受影响婴儿的实验性治疗方法。

paras.en: Working with doctors at the Royal Children's Hospital in Melbourne, the researchers explored whether baricitinib could reduce the excessive inflammatory signaling associated with MKD.
paras.zh: 研究人员与墨尔本皇家儿童医院的医生合作，探索巴瑞替尼是否可以减少与 MKD 相关的过度炎症信号传导。

paras.en: Baricitinib belongs to a class of medications known as JAK inhibitors. These drugs interfere with signaling pathways used by the immune system, including those involved in responses to interferon gamma. The medication is already used to treat other immune-related conditions, including rheumatoid arthritis and eczema.
paras.zh: Baricitinib 属于一类称为 JAK 抑制剂的药物。这些药物会干扰免疫系统使用的信号传导途径，包括那些参与干扰素γ反应的信号传导途径。该药物已用于治疗其他免疫相关疾病，包括类风湿关节炎和湿疹。

paras.en: Doctors added baricitinib to the infant's existing treatment regimen and subsequently observed an improvement in the child's condition. Inflammatory flare-ups became less frequent, and severe inflammation affecting the gastrointestinal tract began to heal.
paras.zh: 医生在婴儿现有的治疗方案中添加了巴瑞替尼，随后观察到孩子的病情有所改善。炎症发作变得不那么频繁，影响胃肠道的严重炎症开始愈合。

paras.en: Although the results from a single patient cannot establish whether the treatment will work more broadly, the improvement provides encouraging early evidence for a strategy that targets a different part of the inflammatory process.
paras.zh: 尽管单个患者的结果无法确定该治疗是否会在更广泛的范围内发挥作用，但这一改进为针对炎症过程不同部分的策略提供了令人鼓舞的早期证据。

paras.en: The researchers believe their findings provide a foundation for future clinical studies investigating JAK inhibitors and other medications that block interferon gamma activity in patients with MKD, particularly those who have not benefited from standard treatments.
paras.zh: 研究人员相信，他们的发现为未来研究 JAK 抑制剂和其他阻断 MKD 患者（尤其是那些未从标准治疗中受益的患者）干扰素伽马活性的药物的临床研究奠定了基础。

paras.en: Discovery Could Help Explain Other Genetic Diseases
paras.zh: 这一发现有助于解释其他遗传疾病

paras.en: The potential implications extend beyond MKD itself.
paras.zh: 潜在的影响超出了 MKD 本身。

paras.en: Researchers have introduced the term 'prenylopathies' to describe a family of genetic disorders involving the same metabolic pathway affected in MKD. Early findings suggest that these related diseases may share a similar underlying problem involving natural killer cells that fail to function properly and instead generate excessive inflammatory signals.
paras.zh: 研究人员引入了“prenylopathies”一词来描述一系列遗传性疾病，涉及与 MKD 受影响的相同代谢途径。早期研究结果表明，这些相关疾病可能存在类似的潜在问题，涉及自然杀伤细胞无法正常发挥作用，反而会产生过多的炎症信号。

paras.en: If further studies confirm this connection, scientists may be able to identify common disease mechanisms and develop more targeted approaches to diagnosis and treatment across multiple disorders.
paras.zh: 如果进一步的研究证实了这种联系，科学家们也许能够确定常见的疾病机制，并开发更有针对性的方法来诊断和治疗多种疾病。

paras.en: "Confirming this link could help end the diagnostic odyssey many patients endure for years or even decades before receiving effective treatment," says Professor Rogers.
paras.zh: 罗杰斯教授说：“证实这种联系可能有助于结束许多患者在接受有效治疗之前忍受数年甚至数十年的诊断过程。”

paras.en: Professor Mike Rogers is a Conjoint Professor at St Vincent's Clinical School, Faculty of Medicine and Health, UNSW Sydney. Dr. Marcia Munoz is a Conjoint Senior Lecturer at St Vincent's Clinical School, Faculty of Medicine and Health, UNSW Sydney.
paras.zh: Mike Rogers 教授是悉尼新南威尔士大学医学与健康学院圣文森特临床学院的联合教授。 Marcia Munoz 博士是悉尼新南威尔士大学医学与健康学院圣文森特临床学院的联合高级讲师。

paras.en: Materials provided by Garvan Institute of Medical Research. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由加文医学研究所提供。注意：内容的风格和长度可能会被编辑。

articles.title: 'A shotgun marriage': Why are NASA's SkyFall Mars helicopters riding on a nuclear rocket?
articles.author: Leonard David

paras.en: The pace is picking up on building, testing, and plotting out the flight paths for a trio of NASA Ingenuity-class helicopters to investigate Mars after riding there on a nuclear-powered rocket.
paras.zh: 美国国家航空航天局（NASA）三架独创级直升机的建造、测试和飞行路线正在加快步伐，这些直升机将乘坐核动力火箭前往火星进行调查。

paras.en: NASA's Skyfall mission will see those mini-choppers dropped off at Mars by the space agency's Space Reactor-1 Freedom (SR-1) rocket, the first fission nuclear-powered interplanetary spacecraft slated for launch in late 2028. After its cruise phase and initial Mars flyby in 2029, that nuclear carrier craft will make a second Mars approach in the Fall of 2030 to unleash a SkyFall entry capsule outfitted with a fleet of small aerial vehicles that will soar across the Red Planet.
paras.zh: NASA 的“天幕杀机”任务将由航天局的 Space Reactor-1 Freedom (SR-1) 火箭将这些小型直升机降落在火星上，这是第一艘裂变核动力星际航天器，计划于 2028 年年底发射。在完成巡航阶段并于 2029 年首次飞越火星后，这艘核运载飞船将在 2030 年秋季第二次接近火星，释放配备了小型飞行器舰队的 SkyFall 进入太空舱它将翱翔在这颗红色星球上。

paras.en: But some experts are questioning why NASA is combining two such high-profile missions into one. "It is clear that SkyFall was approved for programmatic or political reasons," said Scott Hubbard, former director of NASA's Ames Research Center and the first Mars Program Director (aka the "Mars Czar") at NASA Headquarters, told Space.com. "The connection to Space Reactor-1 seems to me to be a bit of a shotgun marriage, a tech-demo piggybacking on another mission as an opening bid for a 'nuclear NASA.'"
paras.zh: 但一些专家质疑美国宇航局为何将两项如此引人注目的任务合二为一。美国宇航局艾姆斯研究中心前主任、美国宇航局总部首任火星计划主任（又名“火星沙皇”）斯科特·哈伯德告诉 Space.com，“很明显，SkyFall 的批准是出于计划或政治原因。” “在我看来，与 Space Reactor-1 的联系有点像霰弹枪联姻，是搭在另一项任务上的技术演示，作为‘核 NASA’的开标。”

paras.en: Hubbard is a retired adjunct professor of aeronautics and astronautics at Stanford University. He is a major voice in shaping Red Planet exploration goals, drawing upon his expertise as NASA's former foremost Mars authority. His understanding is that the basic concept had been developed as a follow on to Ingenuity, an attempt to move beyond a technology demo and into a science platform.
paras.zh: 哈伯德是斯坦福大学航空航天学的退休兼职教授。他利用自己作为美国宇航局前火星权威的专业知识，在制定红色星球探索目标方面发挥了重要作用。他的理解是，基本概念是作为 Ingenuity 的后续发展而来的，是超越技术演示并进入科学平台的尝试。

paras.en: Hubbard said that combining these two observations, the outcome presents "an unusual set of management issues." Since the SkyFall mission concept first appeared, he said, the usual sequence for a science mission is reversed.
paras.zh: 哈伯德说，结合这两个观察结果，结果提出了“一系列不寻常的管理问题”。他说，自从 SkyFall 任务概念首次出现以来，科学任务的通常顺序就被颠倒了。

paras.en: "The science community is having to scramble to back into a set of requirements and objectives that match the SkyFall capabilities. Fortunately the community is very creative," said Hubbard, "and the basic Planetary Decadal objectives are very broad."
paras.zh: “科学界必须争先恐后地制定一套与 SkyFall 功能相匹配的要求和目标。幸运的是，科学界非常有创造力，”哈伯德说，“基本的行星十年目标非常广泛。”

paras.en: Decadal surveys reflect a broad consensus within the scientific community and provide detailed insights into the strategic priorities and mission directives set for the next decade across key scientific domains, including planetary exploration.
paras.zh: 十年调查反映了科学界的广泛共识，并为未来十年在包括行星探索在内的关键科学领域设定的战略优先事项和任务指令提供了详细的见解。

paras.en: However, Hubbard said he has heard griping about the "fait accompli" process, "but the planetary community will make lemonade."
paras.zh: 然而，哈伯德表示，他听到了对“既成事实”过程的抱怨，“但地球社区将制造柠檬水。”

paras.en: It should be noted however, Hubbard continued, that this process is not how you would design a strategic set of missions as precursors for human exploration.
paras.zh: 然而，哈伯德继续说，应该指出的是，这个过程并不是设计一系列战略任务作为人类探索先驱的方式。

paras.en: "SR-1 Freedom is a technology demo that may or may not be ready for the Mars launch window in 2028. It is clear that the Mars Program has a standard launch concept in their back pocket," said Hubbard. "Nuclear Electric Propulsion [NEP] is of little value in traveling to Mars, not shaving any time off the transit. The real value of NEP is for risk reduction, use at the moon, outer planets and even bolder ideas like interstellar travel," Hubbard concluded.
paras.zh: “SR-1 Freedom 是一个技术演示，可能会或可能不会为 2028 年的火星发射窗口做好准备。很明显，火星计划有一个标准的发射概念，”哈伯德说。哈伯德总结道：“核电推进 [NEP] 对于前往火星的旅行没有什么价值，不会缩短运输时间。NEP 的真正价值在于降低风险，在月球、外行星上使用，甚至可以实现星际旅行等更大胆的想法。”

paras.en: "This, by far, is the shortest Mars mission ever conceived of," said Matthew Golombek, SkyFall Project Scientist at NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory in Pasadena, Calif., speaking Nov. 10 during the virtual meeting of the Mars Exploration Program Analysis Group (MEPAG).
paras.zh: 11 月 10 日，位于加利福尼亚州帕萨迪纳的 NASA 喷气推进实验室的 SkyFall 项目科学家 Matthew Golombek 在火星探索计划分析小组 (MEPAG) 的虚拟会议上表示：“这是迄今为止所设想的最短的火星任务。”

paras.en: Kick-started by NASA in March 2026, the SkyFall project has grown from roughly six people to over 200 individuals who are now working on the initiative, said Golombek. "This is an incredibly rapid development and build," he said.
paras.zh: Golombek 表示，SkyFall 项目由 NASA 于 2026 年 3 月发起，目前参与该项目的人员已从大约 6 人增加到 200 多人。 “这是一个令人难以置信的快速开发和建设，”他说。

paras.en: "It's really to demonstrate that exploration is possible with helicopters … filling what I call a 'resolution gap' between orbital information and surface information," Golombek told the MEPAG.
paras.zh: “这确实是为了证明用直升机进行探索是可能的……填补我所说的轨道信息和表面信息之间的‘分辨率差距’，”戈隆贝克告诉 MEPAG。

paras.en: Once deployed by a helicopter deployment system, the threesome will spin up their rotors at about a kilometer above the surface of Mars. Then each helicopter lands on its own, ready to undertake flights every other solar day on the Red Planet. On average, a day (labeled as a sol) on Mars lasts 24 hours 39 minutes 35 seconds, from one noon to the next.
paras.zh: 一旦被直升机部署系统部署，三人组将在火星表面上方约一公里处旋转其旋翼。然后每架直升机自行着陆，准备每隔一个太阳日在这颗红色星球上进行一次飞行。平均而言，火星上的一天（标记为太阳）持续 24 小时 39 分 35 秒，从一个中午到下一个中​​午。

paras.en: SkyFall's prime mission is six months, with a one-year goal," Golombek said, and the intent is to arrive in northern spring on Mars, a time where the vehicles are unlikely to encounter dust storms.
paras.zh: SkyFall 的主要任务是六个月，目标是一年。”戈洛贝克说，其目的是在北部春季抵达火星，此时飞行器不太可能遇到沙尘暴。

paras.en: On the to-do list of NASA level one science requisites are for the helicopters to capture high-resolution imagery, perform a set scientific tasks, and help to prepare for future human exploration of Mars, said Golombek.
paras.zh: 戈隆贝克说，在美国宇航局一级科学需求的待办事项清单中，直升机需要捕获高分辨率图像，执行一系列科学任务，并帮助为未来人类探索火星做好准备。

paras.en: From their initial landing spots, the whirlybirds could potentially go tens to 100's of kilometers or more in different directions. Identical for all three helicopters, the nominal payload consists of five instruments, plus engineering navigation cameras.
paras.zh: 从最初的着陆点开始，旋翼鸟可能会向不同的方向飞行数十到数百公里或更远。与所有三架直升机相同，标称有效载荷由五台仪器以及工程导航摄像机组成。

paras.en: That gear can examine the subsurface structure of Mars, the geomorphology and geology of surface terrains, as well as look at the meteorology of the atmosphere and the planet's radiation environment.
paras.zh: 该设备可以检查火星的地下结构、表面地形的地貌和地质，以及观察大气层的气象和行星的辐射环境。

paras.en: "The real star of the show is ground penetrating radar [GPR] with a flexible antenna," Golombek noted. That ultra-small GPR hardware can look for buried rocks, the layering of the Mars home turf, as well as spot subsurface ice deposits.
paras.zh: “这次展览真正的明星是带有灵活天线的探地雷达 [GPR]，”Golombek 指出。这种超小型探地雷达硬件可以寻找埋藏的岩石、火星主场的分层以及发现地下冰沉积物。

paras.en: "If you have this aerial access and the ability to scout ahead," Golombek said, "you would go a long way towards better defining where to go with a rover and what kind of more detailed surface studies to do with subsequent missions."
paras.zh: 戈隆贝克说：“如果你拥有空中通道和前方侦察能力，那么你将在更好地确定漫游车去往何处以及在后续任务中进行何种更详细的表面研究方面大有帮助。”

paras.en: All that said, yet to be plotted out are science-focused traverses for the SkyFall helicopters. But there are early ideas.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，尚未规划出的是 SkyFall 直升机的以科学为中心的穿越。但有一些早期的想法。

paras.en: "The real kicker is that these spacecraft are the smallest landers ever attempted on Mars," said Golombek. "You are looking for a place that virtually has no rocks," he pointed out, a must-have to assure high probability of landing safely. So toss in for good measure low surface slopes, no big craters, a site not overloaded with dust.
paras.zh: “真正令人兴奋的是，这些航天器是有史以来在火星上尝试过的最小的着陆器，”戈隆贝克说。他指出：“你正在寻找一个几乎没有岩石的地方，”这是确保安全着陆的高概率的必备条件。因此，最好选择低表面坡度、没有大陨石坑、没有灰尘过多的地方。

paras.en: One early idea is to revisit the crash locales of discarded SkyFall descent hardware – fuel tanks, cruise stage and associated gear – equipment large and heavy enough to survive entry, smack into the Mars landscape and high-speed and generate craters.
paras.zh: 一个早期的想法是重新审视废弃的《天幕坠落》下降硬件的坠毁地点——油箱、巡航阶段和相关装备——这些设备又大又重，足以在进入火星时幸存下来，高速撞击火星景观并产生陨石坑。

paras.en: "So if there is ice at centimeters depth, we would create our own icy impact craters," Golombek said. "We could actually visit them in a time-scale before the ice actually sublimates," he said.
paras.zh: “因此，如果有厘米深的冰，我们就会创造自己的冰冷撞击坑，”戈隆贝克说。 “我们实际上可以在冰真正升华之前的时间范围内访问它们，”他说。

paras.en: Another site getting the eye, albeit deemed a design reference target but considered a "pretty good spot," is within Arcadia Planitia in Mars's northern lowlands. Studies have indicated the presence of substantial volumes of near-surface excess ice there.
paras.zh: 另一个引人注目的地点位于火星北部低地的阿卡迪亚平原，尽管被视为设计参考目标，但被认为是“相当不错的地点”。研究表明那里存在大量近地表多余的冰。

paras.en: "There is a vast amount of information to suggest large quantities of regional ice deposits at that location," said Golombek. "This is at least one location that appears to meet all the engineering constraints and would be a potentially safe landing site…virtually no rocks," he advised.
paras.zh: 戈隆贝克说：“大量信息表明该地点存在大量区域性冰沉积物。” “这至少是一个似乎满足所有工程限制的地点，并且将是一个潜在安全的着陆点……几乎没有岩石，”他建议道。

paras.en: In the past, Golombek added, JPL took part in SpaceX-sponsored workshops to look for ice deposits as close to the equator of Mars that could be found. Arcadia Planitia was flagged as superior Starship touchdown terrain.
paras.zh: 戈隆贝克补充说，过去，喷气推进实验室曾参加过 SpaceX 赞助的研讨会，寻找尽可能靠近火星赤道的冰沉积物。阿卡迪亚平原被标记为优越的星舰着陆地形。

paras.en: "Most of the landing sites considered for humans have talked about going to places with ice deposits. Ice provides both a consumable as well as fuel to get back off the planet," said Golombek.
paras.zh: “大多数为人类考虑的着陆点都谈到了前往有冰沉积物的地方。冰既提供了消耗品，也提供了离开地球的燃料，”戈隆贝克说。

paras.en: For the near-term, scientific community input next year — via two workshops — are on tap, reviewing the science of SkyFall and also help sort out potential landing sites for final decision-making at NASA Headquarters.
paras.zh: 就短期而言，科学界明年将通过两个研讨会提供意见，审查 SkyFall 的科学原理，并帮助挑选潜在的着陆地点，以便 NASA 总部做出最终决策。

paras.en: Meanwhile, as SkyFall literally spins up, there is the need for on-time delivery of Space Reactor-1 Freedom.
paras.zh: 与此同时，随着 SkyFall 的实际旋转，需要按时交付 Space Reactor-1 Freedom。

paras.en: Golombek said NASA considers the two endeavors as a pair.
paras.zh: 戈隆贝克表示，美国宇航局将这两项工作视为一对。

paras.en: "If SR-1 is not ready, SkyFall could be launched on any conventional launch vehicle without any difficulty whatsoever," said Golombek, "something like a Falcon 9 would be more than sufficient, but others are possible as well."
paras.zh: 戈隆贝克说：“如果 SR-1 还没有准备好，SkyFall 可以毫无困难地在任何传统运载火箭上发射，像猎鹰 9 号这样的运载火箭就足够了，但其他运载火箭也是可能的。”

paras.en: Leonard David is an award-winning space journalist who has been reporting on space activities for more than 50 years. Currently writing as Space.com's Space Insider Columnist among his other projects, Leonard has authored numerous books on space exploration, Mars missions and more, with his latest being "Moon Rush: The New Space Race" published in 2019 by National Geographic. He also wrote "Mars: Our Future on the Red Planet" released in 2016 by National Geographic. Leonard has served as a correspondent for SpaceNews, Scientific American and Aerospace America for the AIAA. He has received many awards, including the first Ordway Award for Sustained Excellence in Spaceflight History in 2015 at the AAS Wernher von Braun Memorial Symposium. You can find out Leonard's latest project at his website and on Twitter.
paras.zh: Leonard David 是一位屡获殊荣的太空记者，50 多年来一直报道太空活动。伦纳德目前是 Space.com 的 Space Insider 专栏作家，除其他项目外，还撰写了许多有关太空探索、火星任务等的书籍，他的最新著作是国家地理杂志 2019 年出版的《月球冲刺：新太空竞赛》。他还撰写了国家地理杂志于 2016 年发行的《火星：我们在红色星球上的未来》。 Leonard 曾担任 AIAA 的 SpaceNews、Scientific American 和 Aerospace America 的通讯员。他获得了许多奖项，包括 2015 年在美国宇航局沃纳·冯·布劳恩纪念研讨会上获得的首届奥德威太空飞行历史持续卓越奖。您可以在伦纳德的网站和 Twitter 上找到他的最新项目。

articles.title: ULA traces Vulcan Centaur rocket failure to 'inadequate fuel supply' to 1st-stage engines
articles.author: Mike Wall

paras.en: United Launch Alliance (ULA) is getting a handle on why its Vulcan Centaur rocket failed over the weekend.
paras.zh: 联合发射联盟（ULA）正在调查其火神半人马火箭在周末失败的原因。

paras.en: That failure, which occurred during a launch from Florida's Space Coast on Sunday (Nov. 15), led to the loss of 40 Amazon Leo internet satellites. ULA soon traced the anomaly to Vulcan Centaur's first stage, and it has now pinpointed the problem area even further.
paras.zh: 周日（11 月 15 日）在佛罗里达州太空海岸发射时发生的故障导致 40 颗亚马逊 Leo 互联网卫星丢失。 ULA 很快将异常情况追溯到火神半人马座的第一级，现在已经进一步查明了问题区域。

paras.en: "While work remains to determine cause, preliminary indications are that the low booster thrust was the result of inadequate fuel supply from the vehicle to the BE-4 engines, not from the performance of the engines," ULA wrote in an update today (Nov. 18).
paras.zh: ULA 在今天（11 月 18 日）的更新中写道：“虽然仍需确定原因，但初步迹象表明助推器推力低是由于车辆向 BE-4 发动机的燃油供应不足造成的，而不是发动机性能造成的。”

paras.en: This is good news for Blue Origin, Jeff Bezos' aerospace company, which builds the BE-4. Two of these engines power Vulcan's first-stage booster, and they're also key to Blue Origin's New Glenn rocket: That heavy lifter features seven or nine BE-4s in its first stage, depending on the configuration. (New Glenn has its own issues at the moment; it exploded during a test on May 28, and Blue Origin is working to return the powerful rocket to flight.)
paras.zh: 这对于杰夫·贝索斯 (Jeff Bezos) 的航空航天公司 Blue Origin 来说是个好消息，该公司负责制造 BE-4。其中两台发动机为 Vulcan 的第一级助推器提供动力，它们也是 Blue Origin 的 New Glenn 火箭的关键：这款重型升降机在其第一级配备了七到九台 BE-4，具体取决于配置。 （新格伦号目前也有自己的问题；它在 5 月 28 日的测试中爆炸，蓝色起源正在努力让这枚强大的火箭重返飞行。）

paras.en: ULA had already said that Vulcan's six solid rocket boosters (SRBs) and its Centaur V upper stage — which employs a different engine, the RL-10 — seem to perform well on Sunday. Further analysis is firming up that conclusion, according to today's update.
paras.zh: ULA 已经表示，Vulcan 的六个固体火箭助推器 (SRB) 及其 Centaur V 上级（采用不同的发动机 RL-10）似乎在周日表现良好。根据今天的更新，进一步的分析正在证实这一结论。

paras.en: Vulcan has had issues with its SRBs in the past. On the rocket's second and fourth flights — which launched in October 2024 and February of this year, respectively — an SRB nozzle burned through and fell off about 30 seconds into flight. On both occasions, Vulcan overcame the problem and successfully delivered its payload to orbit.
paras.zh: Vulcan 过去曾遇到过 SRB 问题。在火箭的第二次和第四次飞行中（分别于 2024 年 10 月和今年 2 月发射），SRB 喷嘴在飞行约 30 秒后烧穿并脱落。在这两次事件中，火神号都克服了这个问题，并成功地将其有效载荷送入轨道。

paras.en: In the wake of the February flight, ULA and Northrop Grumman, which builds the SRBs, tweaked the nozzle design — a fix that apparently worked, based on Sunday's nominal performance.
paras.zh: 在二月份的飞行之后，ULA 和 SRB 的制造商诺斯罗普·格鲁曼公司调整了喷嘴设计——根据周日的标称性能，这一修复显然有效。

paras.en: Sunday's launch was the fifth ever for the two-stage Vulcan Centaur, the successor to ULA's workhorse Atlas V rocket. Vulcan debuted in January 2024 and has now experienced issues on three of its five flights, though Sunday's was the only one that ended in failure.
paras.zh: 周日的发射是两级 Vulcan Centaur 火箭的第五次发射，它是 ULA 主力 Atlas V 火箭的后继者。 Vulcan 于 2024 年 1 月首次亮相，目前在其五次飞行中的 3 次都遇到了问题，不过周日的航班是唯一一次以失败告终的航班。

paras.en: Vulcan was out of action for about nine months after the February SRB issue. It's unclear how long its current grounding will last; that depends on what ULA's anomaly investigation, which the U.S. Federal Aviation Administration is overseeing, ends up finding.
paras.zh: 自 2 月份 SRB 问题发生后，Vulcan 已停止运行约九个月。目前尚不清楚其目前的停飞状态将持续多久；这取决于由美国联邦航空管理局监督的 ULA 异常调查的最终结果。

paras.en: Michael Wall is the Spaceflight and Tech Editor for Space.com and joined the team in 2010. He primarily covers human and robotic spaceflight, military space, and exoplanets, but has been known to dabble in the space art beat. His book about the search for alien life, "Out There," was published on Nov. 13, 2018. Before becoming a science writer, Michael worked as a herpetologist and wildlife biologist. He has a Ph.D. in evolutionary biology from the University of Sydney, Australia, a bachelor's degree from the University of Arizona, and a graduate certificate in science writing from the University of California, Santa Cruz. To find out what his latest project is, you can follow Michael on Twitter.
paras.zh: Michael Wall 是 Space.com 的太空飞行和技术编辑，于 2010 年加入该团队。他主要报道人类和机器人太空飞行、军事太空和系外行星，但以涉足太空艺术领域而闻名。他关于寻找外星生命的书《Out There》于 2018 年 11 月 13 日出版。在成为科普作家之前，迈克尔曾是一名爬行动物学家和野生动物生物学家。他拥有博士学位。澳大利亚悉尼大学进化生物学博士学位、亚利桑那大学学士学位以及加州大学圣克鲁斯分校科学写作研究生证书。要了解他的最新项目是什么，您可以在 Twitter 上关注 Michael。

articles.title: Earth is missing over a billion years of geological history. Scientists may have discovered why
articles.author: Daisy Dobrijevic

paras.en: More than a billion years of Earth's history has seemingly vanished.
paras.zh: 超过十亿年的地球历史似乎已经消失。

paras.en: Across the planet, ancient rock formations contain colossal gaps in the geological record, leaving scientists puzzled over what happened to the missing chapters of our planet's past.
paras.zh: 在地球上，古老的岩层在地质记录中存在巨大的空白，这让科学家们对地球过去缺失的章节发生了什么感到困惑。

paras.en: Now, researchers believe they may have found an explanation, and the answer lies deep inside Earth.
paras.zh: 现在，研究人员相信他们可能已经找到了解释，而答案就在地球深处。

paras.en: Normally, layers of sediment build up over time, eventually forming sedimentary rocks that preserve clues about our planet's past. Older layers generally lie beneath younger ones, allowing geologists to reconstruct ancient environments and understand how Earth has changed over billions of years.
paras.zh: 通常情况下，沉积物层会随着时间的推移而堆积，最终形成沉积岩，保留有关我们星球过去的线索。较旧的地层通常位于较年轻的地层之下，使地质学家能够重建古代环境并了解地球在数十亿年来的变化。

paras.en: But the geological record isn't always so neatly arranged.
paras.zh: 但地质记录并不总是排列得如此整齐。

paras.en: One of the most striking examples is found in the Grand Canyon, where rocks separated by hundreds of millions of years sit directly on top of one another, as if some force or phenomenon removed the layers that geologists would expect to see in between. This enormous gap in Earth's geological timeline is part of the phenomenon known as the Great Unconformity.
paras.zh: 最引人注目的例子之一是在大峡谷中发现的，那里相隔数亿年的岩石直接相互叠置，就好像某种力量或现象移除了地质学家期望看到的岩石层。地球地质时间线上的巨大差距是大不整合现象的一部分。

paras.en: It's not just the Grand Canyon. Similar gaps have been identified across Europe, Australia, Africa and Asia. Depending on the location, the missing interval ranges from approximately 200 million years to more than a billion years.
paras.zh: 这不仅仅是大峡谷。欧洲、澳大利亚、非洲和亚洲也存在类似的差距。根据位置的不同，缺失的时间间隔从大约 2 亿年到超过 10 亿年不等。

paras.en: "Imagine a book where a huge section in the middle has been ripped out," study lead author Santosh Dhungana said in a statement.
paras.zh: 研究主要作者桑托什·杜加纳（Santosh Dhungana）在一份声明中说：“想象一下，一本书的中间很大一部分被撕掉了。”

paras.en: "The Great Unconformity is that gap in Earth's story, with the narrative jumping from the early chapters straight to a much later part of the story. Our research suggests these pages weren't lost by chance."
paras.zh: “大不整合是地球故事中的一个空白，叙述从早期章节直接跳到故事的后期部分。我们的研究表明这些页面并不是偶然丢失的。”

paras.en: In a new study published in the journal Nature, Dhungana and study co-author Nicolas Flament investigated whether activity far below Earth's surface was to blame.
paras.zh: 在《自然》杂志上发表的一项新研究中，杜加纳和研究合著者尼古拉斯·弗拉门特调查了远低于地球表面的活动是否是罪魁祸首。

paras.en: Using computer models, they explored how the slow circulation of hot rock within Earth's mantle may have affected the continents over hundreds of millions of years.
paras.zh: 他们利用计算机模型探索了地幔内热岩的缓慢循环如何在数亿年来影响大陆。

paras.en: The results suggest that three major ancient continental regions (Laurentia (modern North America), Baltica (northern Europe) and North China were gradually pushed up during the Neoproterozoic Era, approximately one billion to 540 million years ago.
paras.zh: 结果表明，三大古代大陆地区（劳伦西亚（现代北美）、波罗的海（北欧）和华北）在新元古代（大约10亿至5.4亿年前）逐渐被推升。

paras.en: This would have left vast areas of land exposed to weathering and erosion for long periods, allowing water, wind and other processes to wear away rock that had formed much earlier.
paras.zh: 这将使大片土地长期遭受风化和侵蚀，导致水、风和其他过程磨损更早形成的岩石。

paras.en: But removing the rock is only part of the puzzle. They also needed to explain why the gaps are still visible today.
paras.zh: 但移除岩石只是难题的一部分。他们还需要解释为什么这些差距至今仍然可见。

paras.en: Their models suggest that the same regions subsequently began to sink. As sea levels rose relative to the land, sediment accumulated over the older, eroded surfaces, creating the sharp divide between ancient and younger rocks that we can still see today.
paras.zh: 他们的模型表明，同一地区随后开始下沉。随着海平面相对于陆地的上升，沉积物在古老的、被侵蚀的表面上积累，形成了我们今天仍然可以看到的古老和年轻岩石之间的明显鸿沟。

paras.en: Crucially, the researchers found that the timing of the simulated continental uplift and sinking was consistent with geological evidence from North America, northern Europe and North China. This suggests that movements deep within Earth's mantle may have played a major role in shaping the geological record we see today.
paras.zh: 至关重要的是，研究人员发现模拟的大陆隆起和下沉的时间与北美、北欧和华北的地质证据一致。这表明地幔深处的运动可能在塑造我们今天看到的地质记录方面发挥了重要作用。

paras.en: Daisy Dobrijevic joined Space.com in February 2022, having previously worked as a staff writer for All About Space magazine. She completed an editorial internship with BBC Sky at Night Magazine and worked at the National Space Centre, communicating space science to the public.
paras.zh: Daisy Dobrijevic 于 2022 年 2 月加入 Space.com，此前曾担任《All About Space》杂志的特约撰稿人。她完成了 BBC Sky 夜间杂志的编辑实习，并在国家航天中心工作，向公众传播空间科学。

paras.en: Daisy holds a PhD in plant physiology and a Master's in Environmental Science. Based in Nottingham, U.K., she covers all things space, with a special focus on solar activity and space weather. She also has a keen interest in astrotourism and is always on the lookout for the next northern lights adventure.
paras.zh: 黛西拥有植物生理学博士学位和环境科学硕士学位。她居住在英国诺丁汉，研究太空的所有事物，特别关注太阳活动和太空天气。她还对天文旅游有着浓厚的兴趣，并且总是在寻找下一次北极光冒险。

paras.en: She will join Hurtigruten as an onboard astronomer for a northern lights sailing in January 2027.
paras.zh: 她将作为船上天文学家加入海达路德号，于 2027 年 1 月进行北极光航行。

articles.title: SpaceNukes Opens Los Alamos Manufacture and Materials Facility to Build Its Next-Generation Space Reactor
articles.author: Space Nuclear Power Corporation

paras.en: LOS ALAMOS, N.M., Nov. 16, 2026 — Space Nuclear Power Corp. (SpaceNukes) opened its Manufacture and Materials Development Facility at 150 Central Park Square in Los Alamos on Nov. 13. The facility is dedicated to manufacture and materials development for the company’s Generation 2 reactor, including additive manufacturing of nickel-based and refractory alloys. No radioactive material is handled in the facility.
paras.zh: 新墨西哥州洛斯阿拉莫斯，2026 年 11 月 16 日 — Space Nuclear Power Corp. (SpaceNukes) 于 11 月 13 日在洛斯阿拉莫斯中央公园广场 150 号开设了制造和材料开发设施。该设施致力于该公司第二代反应堆的制造和材料开发，包括镍基和耐火合金的增材制造。该设施内不处理任何放射性物质。

paras.en: SpaceNukes’ next-generation reactor is designed to run much hotter. A hotter reactor needs a much smaller radiator, which makes up most of the mass of a space fission power system. Raising the temperature at which heat is rejected lets the same-size radiator shed roughly six times as much heat. The limit is not the nuclear physics but the materials. Today’s power conversion hardware already sits at the edge of what nickel-based superalloys tolerate over a long mission, so going hotter means moving to refractory alloys of tungsten, molybdenum, tantalum, rhenium and niobium. These metals are difficult to form, and many of the component shapes and materials SpaceNukes needs cannot be bought from any supplier.
paras.zh: SpaceNukes 的下一代反应堆设计为运行温度更高。更热的反应堆需要更小的散热器，它构成了空间裂变动力系统的大部分质量。提高散热温度可以让相同尺寸的散热器散发出大约六倍的热量。限制不是核物理而是材料。当今的电力转换硬件已经处于镍基高温合金长期任务承受能力的边缘，因此变得更热意味着转向钨、钼、钽、铼和铌的难熔合金。这些金属很难成型，而且 SpaceNukes 所需的许多部件形状和材料无法从任何供应商处购买。

paras.en: “Our next-generation reactor is a bet on temperature,” said Andrew Phelps, CEO of SpaceNukes. “What stands between us and that is not the nuclear physics. The physics is in good shape, and it was proven in 2018. The limit is metal. Our next reactor is a materials and manufacturing challenge before it is a reactor problem, and that is what this building is for.”
paras.zh: SpaceNukes 首席执行官安德鲁·菲尔普斯 (Andrew Phelps) 表示：“我们的下一代反应堆押注于温度。” “阻碍我们的不是核物理学。物理学状况良好，并在 2018 年得到了证明。限制是金属。我们的下一个反应堆在成为反应堆问题之前首先是材料和制造挑战，而这就是这座建筑的用途。”

paras.en: The facility is led by Omar Mireles, director of manufacture and materials, who heads the Generation 2 program. Mireles spent 13 years as a research engineer and principal investigator at NASA’s Marshall Space Flight Center, where he led the $25 million Refractory Alloy Additive Manufacturing Build Optimization project.
paras.zh: 该工厂由制造和材料总监 Omar Mireles 领导，他也是第二代项目的负责人。 Mireles 在 NASA 马歇尔太空飞行中心担任了 13 年的研究工程师和首席研究员，领导了价值 2500 万美元的耐火合金增材制造构建优化项目。

paras.en: “Additive manufacturing is used only for specific circumstances,” Mireles said. “You have parts that are highly complex, made from materials that are difficult to form, have a low production rate that won’t benefit from economy of scale, and have the design flexibility that can optimize designs to the manufacturing process. These lessons were learned over the last two decades in the liquid rocket engine community, and we are applying them to the needs of SpaceNukes, which have very similar conditions. We are manufacturing aerospace components at aerospace-quality standards. This building is where we learn to make them.”
paras.zh: “增材制造仅用于特定情况，”米雷莱斯说。 “零件高度复杂，由难以成型的材料制成，生产率低，无法从规模经济中受益，并且具有可以优化制造过程设计的设计灵活性。这些经验教训是液体火箭发动机界在过去二十年中吸取的经验教训，我们正在将它们应用于具有非常相似条件的 SpaceNukes 的需求。我们正在按照航空航天质量标准制造航空航天部件。这座建筑是我们学习制造它们的地方。”

paras.en: The Los Alamos facility complements SpaceNukes’ integration and test facility in Medina, Ohio, led by chief engineer Marc Gibson. SpaceNukes is now building hardware to test components for its Generation 2 reactors at the Ohio facility.
paras.zh: 洛斯阿拉莫斯工厂补充了 SpaceNukes 位于俄亥俄州麦地那的集成和测试工厂，该工厂由总工程师马克·吉布森 (Marc Gibson) 领导。 SpaceNukes 目前正在俄亥俄州工厂建造硬件来测试其第二代反应堆的组件。

paras.en: The grand opening featured remarks from Phelps and Mireles, a ribbon cutting and tours of the new facility. Guests included staff from the office of Sen. Martin Heinrich, D-N.M.; Los Alamos National Laboratory and its Feynman Center for Innovation; the Los Alamos County Council; the Los Alamos County Community Development Department; the Los Alamos Commerce & Development Corp.; the Los Alamos Chamber of Commerce; Century Bank; Merrill Lynch; and space industry partners.
paras.zh: 菲尔普斯和米雷莱斯在盛大的开幕式上致辞，并剪彩并参观了新设施。嘉宾包括新墨西哥州民主党参议员马丁·海因里希 (Martin Heinrich) 办公室的工作人员；洛斯阿拉莫斯国家实验室及其费曼创新中心；洛斯阿拉莫斯县议会；洛斯阿拉莫斯县社区发展部；洛斯阿拉莫斯商业发展公司；洛斯阿拉莫斯商会；世纪银行；美林；以及航天工业合作伙伴。

paras.en: The facility opening follows SpaceNukes’ Oct. 21 announcement of an agreement with the Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency, under its Fast Capacitance (Fat Cat) program, to design, build and ground-test an actively controlled Kilopower reactor with Los Alamos National Laboratory. It comes as SpaceNukes works to fly a nuclear reactor by 2028.
paras.zh: 该设施开业之前，SpaceNukes 于 10 月 21 日宣布与国防高级研究计划局达成协议，根据其快速电容 (Fat Cat) 计划，与洛斯阿拉莫斯国家实验室一起设计、建造和地面测试主动控制 Kilopower 反应堆。 SpaceNukes 正致力于在 2028 年之前飞行一座核反应堆。

paras.en: Space Nuclear Power Corp. (SpaceNukes) builds nuclear reactors that power missions in space for government and commercial clients. In March 2018, the team that is now SpaceNukes ran a space reactor at full temperature and power for 28 hours, and it performed as predicted. It was the first time this had been done in the United States in 50 years. The team took it from concept to full power in three years for less than $20 million. Today, SpaceNukes has roughly 15 full-time employees, more than $50 million in contracts and agreements with the Department of War and NASA, two completed Space Force design reviews and a Los Alamos National Laboratory license for the reactor technology its founders invented there. Space Nuclear Power Corp., headquartered in Los Alamos, New Mexico, is committed to delivering safe, affordable, reliable nuclear power wherever people and machines go in space.
paras.zh: 太空核动力公司 (SpaceNukes) 建造核反应堆，为政府和商业客户的太空任务提供动力。 2018 年 3 月，SpaceNukes 团队在全温度和全功率下运行了一个空间反应堆 28 小时，其性能符合预期。这是美国 50 年来首次这样做。该团队用了不到 2000 万美元的时间，在三年内将其从概念转变为全面发挥作用。如今，SpaceNukes 拥有大约 15 名全职员工，与战争部和 NASA 签订了价值超过 5000 万美元的合同和协议，完成了两项太空部队设计审查，并为其创始人在洛斯阿拉莫斯国家实验室发明的反应堆技术获得了许可证。太空核电公司总部位于新墨西哥州洛斯阿拉莫斯，致力于为人类和机器进入太空的任何地方提供安全、负担得起、可靠的核电。

paras.en: Andrew Phelps, CEO, Space Nuclear Power Corp.
paras.zh: 安德鲁·菲尔普斯 (Andrew Phelps)，太空核电公司首席执行官

articles.title: Origami and solar arrays
articles.author: SpaceNews Editor

paras.en: In this episode of SpaceMinds, SpaceNews’ Mike Gruss talks with Thomas Sinn, the CEO of Dcubed, at Space Tech Expo Europe. They discuss the company’s new $30 million funding round, how to think of solar arrays like origami and the increasing power demands required for space.
paras.zh: 在这一集中的 SpaceMinds 中，SpaceNews 的 Mike Gruss 在欧洲航天科技博览会上与 Dcubed 首席执行官 Thomas Sinn 进行了交谈。他们讨论了该公司新一轮 3000 万美元的融资、如何考虑折纸等太阳能电池阵列以及太空所需不断增长的电力需求。
