It's quite a mouthful, but essentially what it means is the U.S. and China have agreed they're going to continue to compete but that there should be guardrails. So let's take a look at this Nvidia story. Last week the chief stepped down, and really at the heart of that story are allegations of Chinese espionage and smuggling of high-end U.S. chips to China.
paras.zh: 帕克：是的。我的意思是，这次会议和其他会议一样，都是为了定下基调。双方已就所谓的建设性战略稳定达成一致。这听起来很拗口，但本质上意味着美国和中国已经同意他们将继续竞争，但应该有护栏。那么让我们来看看这个 Nvidia 的故事。上周这位负责人下台，真正的核心是对中国间谍活动和向中国走私高端美国芯片的指控。

paras.en: But here today, Trump just arrived, and Xi is meeting him at the airport to greet him. So this is really a case emblematic of the parallel track of the U.S.-China relationship, according to Ja Ian Chong. This is an analyst on Chinese politics at the National University of Singapore.
paras.zh: 但今天，特朗普刚刚抵达，习近平正在机场迎接他。 Ja Ian Chong 表示，这确实是美中关系平行轨道的一个典型案例。这是新加坡国立大学的中国政治分析师。

paras.en: JA IAN CHONG: So the good relationship on the surface, but supposedly efforts to get restricted U.S. chips, espionage, all that continues.
paras.zh: JA IAN CHONG：表面上关系良好，但据称为获取受限制的美国芯片而进行的努力、间谍活动等等仍在继续。

paras.en: MARTÍNEZ: And the two leaders, Trump and Xi, will be joined by a third, Russian president Vladimir Putin, for a trilateral meeting. Jennifer, it can't get more different in priorities. So what are we expecting there?
paras.zh: 马丁内斯：特朗普和习近平两位领导人将与俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京一起参加三边会议。詹妮弗，事情的优先顺序完全不同了。那么我们在那里期待什么呢？

paras.en: PAK: Well, probably more optics, according to Chong. So Trump has talked about bringing up the topic of nuclear arms control. Beijing hasn't been very keen on this because, you know, of the three, it has the smallest nuclear arsenal stock. And then you have Putin who wants to talk potentially about a peace deal in Russia's war with Ukraine, but on Moscow's terms. China has always said that Europe should be at the table. But what China's really interested in, according to Chong, is projecting a certain image on the global stage.
paras.zh: PAK：根据 Chong 的说法，可能是更多的光学器件。所以特朗普谈到了核军控的话题。北京对此不太热衷，因为你知道，在这三个国家中，它拥有的核武库最少。然后普京可能希望就俄罗斯与乌克兰的战争达成和平协议，但要按照莫斯科的条件。中国一直表示欧洲应该参与谈判。但据钟说，中国真正感兴趣的是在全球舞台上塑造某种形象。

paras.en: CHONG: China is what it tries to present as a stabilizing force, as the sort of more predictable major power that others should look to Beijing for cooperation.
paras.zh: 庄：中国试图将其描绘成一股稳定力量，一种更可预测的大国，其他国家应该向北京寻求合作。

paras.en: PAK: So China wants to show it's going to be a world leader that doesn't just make decisions without the input of smaller countries, and that really resonates with them because here - I'm at a regional forum where a lot of smaller countries want to make sure they have a say so in their region.
paras.zh: 帕克：所以中国希望表明，它将成为一个世界领导者，它不会在没有小国参与的情况下做出决定，这确实能引起他们的共鸣，因为在这里——我在一个地区论坛上，许多小国希望确保他们在自己的地区有发言权。

paras.en: MARTÍNEZ: That's our China correspondent, Jennifer Pak. Hope the humanoid coffee is good, Jennifer.
paras.zh: 马丁内斯：这是我们驻中国记者詹妮弗·帕克。希望人形咖啡好喝，詹妮弗。

paras.en: Accuracy and availability of transcripts for NPR programming may vary. Transcript text may also be revised to correct errors or match updates to audio. Audio may be edited after its original broadcast or publication. The authoritative record of NPR’s programming is the audio record.
paras.zh: NPR 节目文字记录的准确性和可用性可能会有所不同。转录文本也可能会被修改以纠正错误或匹配音频更新。音频可以在其原始广播或出版后进行编辑。 NPR 节目的权威记录是音频记录。

articles.title: Mary Peltola flips Alaska's Senate seat. And, Nvidia won't reinstate Jensen Huang
articles.author: Brittney Melton

paras.en: Mary Peltola flips Alaska's Senate seat. And, Nvidia won't reinstate Jensen Huang
paras.zh: 玛丽·佩尔托拉推翻了阿拉斯加州的参议院席位。而且，英伟达不会恢复黄仁勋的职位

paras.en: Former Democratic Rep. Mary Peltola has defeated Republican Sen. Dan S. Sullivan in Alaska's U.S. Senate race, according to The Associated Press. Her victory gives Democrats 56 senators in the upcoming Congress. Alaska uses ranked-choice voting for its general election, but Peltola secured a majority of first-place votes, eliminating the need for ranked-choice calculations. Her win flips a Senate seat in a state that President Trump won by 13 percentage points in 2024. The race's final days were tumultuous due to allegations that Peltola's team tried to recruit another candidate to the race to siphon votes from the incumbent. Peltola's campaign denied any involvement.
paras.zh: 据美联社报道，前民主党众议员玛丽·佩尔托拉在阿拉斯加州的美国参议员竞选中击败了共和党参议员丹·S·沙利文。她的胜利使民主党在即将到来的国会中拥有 56 名参议员。阿拉斯加在大选中使用排名选择投票，但佩尔托拉获得了大多数第一名选票，从而消除了排名选择计算的需要。她的胜利扭转了特朗普总统在 2024 年以 13 个百分点获胜的州的参议院席位。由于有人指控佩尔托拉的团队试图招募另一位候选人参加竞选，以从现任总统手中夺取选票，因此竞选的最后几天非常混乱。佩尔托拉的竞选团队否认有任何参与。

paras.en: Trump has arrived in the Southern Chinese city of Shenzhen, where he is set to meet with China's President Xi Jinping on Thursday. This will mark the third time these two leaders have met this year. They are expected to discuss trade, investment and tariffs, which are currently on hold.
paras.zh: 特朗普已抵达中国南方城市深圳，定于周四与中国国家主席习近平会面。这将是两位领导人今年第三次会面。预计他们将讨论目前搁置的贸易、投资和关税问题。

paras.en: - 🎧 The meeting is about establishing a tone, as the U.S. and China have agreed to have constructive strategic stability, NPR's Jennifer Pak tells Up First. The two leaders will later be joined by Russian President Vladimir Putin for a trilateral meeting. The trio may discuss a peace deal for Russia's war in Ukraine, but China says that Europe must be included. Pak says China wants to show that a world leader won't make decisions without input from smaller countries. This is especially significant, Pak says, because these meetings take place on the sidelines of the Asia Pacific Economic Cooperation forum (APEC), where many smaller nations seek a voice in regional matters.
paras.zh: - 🎧 NPR 的 Jennifer Pak 告诉 Up First，此次会议旨在确定基调，因为美国和中国已同意建立建设性的战略稳定。俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京随后将与两位领导人一起举行三边会议。三人可能会讨论俄罗斯乌克兰战争的和平协议，但中国表示欧洲必须参与其中。帕克表示，中国希望表明，世界领导人不会在没有小国参与的情况下做出决定。帕克说，这一点尤其重要，因为这些会议是在亚太经济合作论坛（APEC）期间举行的，许多小国在该论坛上寻求在地区事务中发表意见。

paras.en: Nvidia board chairman Harvey Jones said in an earnings call yesterday that the board does not intend to reinstate former CEO Jensen Huang. Huang "voluntarily resigned" on Nov. 12 after disclosing "personal behavior inconsistent with the company's code of conduct," according to Jones. Huang acknowledged he had been unfaithful to his wife. News reports have tied him to a woman who U.S. intelligence officials say was recruited by China's spy agency. The board unanimously accepted his resignation. Earlier yesterday, Huang said he would return as CEO if the board permitted it and agreed to testify before Congress regarding national security issues surrounding the company.
paras.zh: 英伟达董事会主席哈维琼斯在昨天的财报电话会议上表示，董事会不打算恢复前首席执行官黄仁勋的职位。琼斯表示，黄在披露“个人行为不符合公司行为准则”后，于 11 月 12 日“主动辞职”。黄承认他对妻子不忠。新闻报道称他与一名女性有联系，美国情报官员称该女性是由中国间谍机构招募的。董事会一致接受了他的辞职。昨天早些时候，黄仁勋表示，如果董事会允许，他将重新担任首席执行官，并同意就公司的国家安全问题在国会作证。

paras.en: - 🎧 NPR's John Ruwitch said that Jones clearly wanted to dispel rumors, and showed support for interim CEO Colette Kress. He said she "has been at the center of the company's extraordinary growth." Kress also participated in the call, maintaining a business-as-usual demeanor, Ruwitch says. Nvidia posted revenue exceeding $115 billion for the quarter, which isn't surprising, as the numbers were secured before Huang's recent departure. Tech analyst Gaurav Gupta from Gartner tells Ruwitch that any impact from new leadership won't be reflected in the numbers for several months. Jones said the board would try to decide on a permanent CEO as soon as possible without rushing the decision.
paras.zh: - 🎧 NPR 的 John Ruwitch 表示，琼斯显然是想辟谣，并对临时首席执行官 Colette Kress 表示支持。他说她“一直是公司非凡发展的核心”。鲁维奇说，克雷斯也参加了电话会议，保持着一切如常的态度。 Nvidia 公布本季度收入超过 1150 亿美元，这并不奇怪，因为这些数字在黄最近离职之前就已经确定了。 Gartner 的技术分析师 Gaurav Gupta 告诉 Ruwitch，新领导层的任何影响在几个月内都不会反映在数据中。琼斯表示，董事会将尽力尽快决定永久首席执行官的人选，但不会仓促做出决定。

paras.en: Major organizations have been experiencing widespread crashes of computer and online systems. Apple reported significant outages yesterday, and the U.S. National Security Agency also experienced a breakdown. As of this morning, no major disruptions seem to be occurring. Secretary of State Marco Rubio said there is no evidence that these incidents are related to one another or involve a malign actor or cybercriminal.
paras.zh: 主要组织都经历过广泛的计算机和在线系统崩溃。苹果公司昨天报告了严重的服务中断，美国国家安全局也出现了故障。截至今天早上，似乎没有发生重大干扰。美国国务卿马可·卢比奥表示，没有证据表明这些事件相互关联或涉及恶意行为者或网络犯罪分子。

paras.en: - 🎧 Cyber experts tell NPR's Greg Myre that artificial intelligence is uncovering previously undetected software flaws at an unprecedented pace. Companies are racing to patch or upgrade to address these vulnerabilities, but working under tight deadlines often leads to mistakes. As many systems undergo upgrades, people should anticipate disruptions along the way, Myre says. However, the optimistic perspective is that computer networks are expected to become more robust and resilient within the next year or two due to the improvements.
paras.zh: - 🎧 网络专家告诉 NPR 的 Greg Myre，人工智能正在以前所未有的速度发现以前未被发现的软件缺陷。公司正在竞相修补或升级以解决这些漏洞，但在紧迫的期限内工作往往会导致错误。迈尔说，随着许多系统进行升级，人们应该预见到升级过程中可能会出现的中断。然而，乐观的观点是，由于这些改进，计算机网络预计将在未来一两年内变得更加强大和有弹性。

paras.en: In recent years, highly concentrated products containing 7-hydroxymitragynine (7-OH) have emerged online and at smoke shops, liquor stores and gas stations. These products, available as tablets, gummies, tonics and chocolates, contain one of the major psychoactive ingredients in kratom. Unlike kratom leaf products, 7-OH acts more like an opioid in the human brain. Some people use kratom to maintain long-term recovery from opioid addiction. Others say it helps them feel energized or focused. Users of 7-OH and kratom can show signs of addiction, and unclear product labeling makes it hard to determine the quantities consumed. Over the past decade, the U.S. government has tried to restrict these products, but public opposition has kept them legal. Recently, this situation has started to change.
paras.zh: 近年来，含有 7-羟基帽柱木碱 (7-OH) 的高浓度产品出现在网上以及烟店、酒类商店和加油站。这些产品以片剂、软糖、补品和巧克力的形式提供，含有卡痛叶中主要的精神活性成分之一。与卡痛叶产品不同，7-OH 在人脑中的作用更像是阿片类药物。有些人使用卡痛叶来维持阿片类药物成瘾的长期康复。其他人则表示这可以帮助他们感到精力充沛或集中注意力。 7-OH 和卡痛叶的使用者可能会表现出上瘾的迹象，而且产品标签不明确导致很难确定食用量。过去十年来，美国政府一直试图限制这些产品，但公众的反对使它们保持合法。最近，这种情况开始发生变化。

paras.en: - ➡️ In August, the Drug Enforcement Administration restricted the manufacture and sale of three semi-synthetic opioids from 7-OH and other related compounds. They were classified under the Controlled Substances Act alongside drugs like heroin and LSD.
paras.zh: - ➡️ 8 月，缉毒局限制生产和销售三种由 7-OH 和其他相关化合物制成的半合成阿片类药物。它们与海洛因和迷幻药等毒品一起​​被归入《管制物质法》。

paras.en: - ➡️ Kratom advocates were concerned that new rules would impact products with "trace amounts" of the opioid MGPI. The American Kratom Association filed a federal lawsuit against the DEA on Aug. 26, seeking to keep natural kratom products with MGPI legal.
paras.zh: - ➡️ Kratom 倡导者担心新规则会影响含有“微量”阿片类药物 MGPI 的产品。美国卡痛叶协会于8月26日对DEA提起联邦诉讼，寻求保持具有MGPI的天然卡痛叶产品的合法性。

paras.en: - ➡️ On Oct. 9, the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) issued a new recommendation on 7-OH and MGPI, leading the DEA to revise its stance to focus on restricting products with higher concentrations of these substances.
paras.zh: - ➡️10月9日，美国卫生与公众服务部（HHS）发布了关于7-OH和MGPI的新建议，导致DEA修改立场，重点限制这些物质浓度较高的产品。

paras.en: - ➡️ Opponents of the restriction argue that the products helped them avoid traditional opioids. Some point to the decrease in opioid deaths in the U.S.
paras.zh: - ➡️ 该限制的反对者认为，这些产品帮助他们避免了传统的阿片类药物。一些人指出美国阿片类药物死亡人数有所下降

paras.en: - ➡️ The National Institute on Drug Abuse says that early studies indicate kratom and its compounds deserve more exploration as experimental treatments for substance use disorders, specifically opioid use disorder.
paras.zh: - ➡️国家药物滥用研究所表示，早期研究表明卡痛叶及其化合物值得更多探索，作为物质使用障碍（特别是阿片类药物使用障碍）的实验治疗方法。

paras.en: Family physician Mara Gordon answers reader health questions monthly for NPR's special series Real Talk with a Doc. Send in your question to thrive@npr.org.
paras.zh: 家庭医生玛拉·戈登 (Mara Gordon) 每月都会在 NPR 的特别系列《与医生真实交谈》中回答读者的健康问题。将您的问题发送至繁荣@npr.org。

paras.en: Artificial intelligence scribes help doctors take notes in various settings, from gynecologist visits to emergency rooms. Dr. Gordon says the technology saves time and allows her to focus entirely on her patients without the distraction of multitasking. But she also understands why patients might feel uneasy about new technology, and says she shares their concerns about privacy. Here's what Dr. Gordon says you should know about AI scribes:
paras.zh: 人工智能抄写员帮助医生在各种情况下做笔记，从妇科医生就诊到急诊室。戈登医生说，这项技术节省了时间，让她能够完全专注于患者，而不会因多任务处理而分心。但她也理解为什么患者可能会对新技术感到不安，并表示她和他们一样对隐私感到担忧。以下是戈登博士所说的关于人工智能抄写员你应该了解的内容：

paras.en: - 🩺 The scribe uses "automatic speech recognition" technology to record the conversation between the doctor and the patient. After the visit, the recording is transcribed and turned into a medical note of the exam's findings and the doctor's decisions.
paras.zh: - 🩺 抄写员使用“自动语音识别”技术记录医生和患者之间的对话。就诊后，录音将被转录并转化为检查结果和医生决定的医疗记录。

paras.en: - 🩺 Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) compliance is crucial for AI scribe services to ensure they protect patient privacy. Software companies must safeguard data by encrypting it, controlling access and implementing systems to prevent data breaches. Most companies delete recorded conversations after a specified period.
paras.zh: - 🩺 健康保险流通与责任法案 (HIPAA) 合规性对于 AI 抄写员服务确保保护患者隐私至关重要。软件公司必须通过加密、控制访问和实施系统来保护数据以防止数据泄露。大多数公司会在指定时间段后删除录制的对话。

paras.en: - 🩺 AI scribes can make mistakes, which is why doctors must review AI-generated notes before signing them and adding them to the medical record. Most AI scribe software requires doctors to sign a user agreement, making them liable for all content in the medical record.
paras.zh: - 🩺 人工智能抄写员可能会犯错误，这就是为什么医生在签署并将其添加到医疗记录之前必须审查人工智能生成的笔记。大多数人工智能抄写软件都要求医生签署用户协议，使他们对病历中的所有内容负责。

paras.en: - 🩺Many AI scribes can only be used with English-speaking patients. Health equity advocates have raised concerns that this could widen health disparities.
paras.zh: - 🩺许多AI抄写员只能与说英语的患者一起使用。健康公平倡导者担心这可能会扩大健康差距。

paras.en: - 🩺 You can always opt out of using an AI scribe during your doctor's visit. But opting out of AI in medicine more broadly could be tricky.
paras.zh: - 🩺 在您就诊期间，您随时可以选择不使用人工智能抄写员。但在更广泛的医学领域选择退出人工智能可能会很棘手。

paras.en: - NPR's Breakfast Around the World series is spotlighting Lebanon's man'ouché, a beloved breakfast flatbread. It's a U.N.-certified part of intangible cultural heritage, with a unique twist crafted by generations of Lebanese.
paras.zh: - NPR 的“世界早餐”系列重点关注黎巴嫩的 man'ouché，这是一种深受人们喜爱的早餐大饼。它是经联合国认证的非物质文化遗产的一部分，具有几代黎巴嫩人精心打造的独特风格。

paras.en: - The Pan American Health Organization announced yesterday that the U.S. has lost its measles elimination status. It is now considered endemic because a strain has persisted in the country for more than a year.
paras.zh: - 泛美卫生组织昨天宣布，美国已失去麻疹消除地位。它现在被认为是地方病，因为该菌株已在该国持续存在了一年多。

paras.en: - The oldest survivor of the Japanese attack on Pearl Harbor, Freeman Johnson, died this weekend at his Cape Cod home at the age of 106.
paras.zh: - 日本偷袭珍珠港事件中最年长的幸存者弗里曼·约翰逊 (Freeman Johnson) 于本周末在科德角的家中去世，享年 106 岁。

articles.title: Karl Kani dressed hip-hop royalty for decades. Now he's telling his own story
articles.author: Ruby Siefken

paras.en: Karl Kani dressed hip-hop royalty for decades. Now he's telling his own story
paras.zh: 几十年来，卡尔·卡尼 (Karl Kani) 一直为嘻哈皇室着装。现在他正在讲述自己的故事

paras.en: Fashion designer Karl Kani believes hip-hop needed its own clothing brand, one that reflected the music, culture and style of the artists who were changing fashion in the 1990s.
paras.zh: 时装设计师 Karl Kani 认为嘻哈音乐需要自己的服装品牌，该品牌能够反映 20 世纪 90 年代改变时尚的艺术家的音乐、文化和风格。

paras.en: "Hip-hop needed the clothing brand that fit that look, who was from the culture," Kani told NPR's A Martínez on Morning Edition. "And I felt like the marriage between Kani and hip-hop was, like, heaven-sent."
paras.zh: “嘻哈需要适合这种外观、来自文化的服装品牌，”卡尼在早间版节目中告诉 NPR 的 A Martínez。 “我觉得卡尼和嘻哈之间的联姻就像是天赐良机。”

paras.en: Kani, born Carl Williams, started designing clothing in Brooklyn, New York, in the late 1980s. He was inspired by watching his father, a Haitian tailor, make matching linen suits to sell around the neighborhood.
paras.zh: 卡尼 (Kani) 原名卡尔·威廉姆斯 (Carl Williams)，于 20 世纪 80 年代末在纽约布鲁克林开始设计服装。他的灵感来自于观看他的父亲（一名海地裁缝）制作配套的亚麻西装并在附近出售。

paras.en: At the time, hip-hop artists were already wearing names like Ralph Lauren, Tommy Hilfiger and Calvin Klein. But they weren't necessarily wearing the clothes as their designers intended. They favored oversized fits, mixed colors and created looks of their own.
paras.zh: 当时，嘻哈艺术家已经开始使用 Ralph Lauren、Tommy Hilfiger 和 Calvin Klein 等品牌的服饰。但他们不一定按照设计师的意图穿着这些衣服。她们喜欢大廓形、混合颜色并创造自己的外观。

paras.en: Kani understood the appeal. He began making clothes as a self-taught designer in Brooklyn, New York, in the late 1980s. He helped turn that emerging streetwear style into a brand worn by some of hip-hop's biggest stars, including Tupac Shakur, Aaliyah and The Notorious B.I.G.
paras.zh: 卡尼理解这种呼吁。 20 世纪 80 年代末，他在纽约布鲁克林作为一名自学成才的设计师开始制作服装。他帮助将这种新兴的街头服饰风格转变为一些嘻哈巨星所穿着的品牌，其中包括 Tupac Shakur、Aaliyah 和 The Notorious B.I.G.

paras.en: But the designer's ambitions extended beyond dressing famous musicians. He wanted to build an international fashion business that could last.
paras.zh: 但设计师的野心不仅仅局限于为著名音乐家设计服装。他想建立一个能够持续发展的国际时尚企业。

paras.en: In his new memoir, Karl Kani: A Life By Design, Kani reflects on the creative instincts and business decisions that helped his brand survive long after the decade that made it famous.
paras.zh: 在他的新回忆录《卡尔·卡尼：设计人生》中，卡尼反思了帮助他的品牌在成名十年后长期生存的创意本能和商业决策。

paras.en: Even his name reflects his ambitions. Kani, pronounced like "Can I?," came from the doubts he faced while building his business.
paras.zh: 甚至他的名字也反映了他的野心。卡尼（Kani）的发音类似于“Can I？”，来自他在建立业务时面临的疑虑。

paras.en: "Can I really come from the inner city and build a clothing brand?" he recalled asking himself. "I didn't know the answer to that question, but I knew if I call myself Kani, then every day I have to answer that question. Yes, I can."
paras.zh: “我真的可以从内城过来，打造一个服装品牌吗？”他记得自己问过自己。 “我不知道这个问题的答案，但我知道如果我称自己为卡尼，那么我每天都必须回答这个问题。是的，我可以。”

paras.en: After more than three decades in fashion, Kani also has some thoughts about what hasn't aged quite so gracefully: men in skinny jeans.
paras.zh: 在时尚界工作了三十多年后，卡尼也对那些没有如此优雅地变老的事物有了一些想法：穿紧身牛仔裤的男人。

paras.en: "I feel like a lot of guys kind of messed up when the skinny jeans phase came in," he said.
paras.zh: “我觉得当紧身牛仔裤时代到来时，很多人都搞砸了，”他说。

paras.en: His advice? "Keep it simple, keep it slick and all black. You can never go wrong in all black."
paras.zh: 他的建议？ “保持简单、光滑和全黑。全黑永远不会出错。”

paras.en: In his conversation with NPR's A Martínez, Kani discusses his new memoir, the rise of his streetwear empire, hip-hop's influence on fashion and why skinny jeans aren't for everyone.
paras.zh: 在与 NPR 的 A Martínez 的对话中，Kani 讨论了他的新回忆录、街头服饰帝国的崛起、嘻哈音乐对时尚的影响以及为什么紧身牛仔裤并不适合所有人。

paras.en: Listen to the full interview by clicking the blue button above.
paras.zh: 单击上面的蓝色按钮收听完整采访。

articles.title: Heat vs. Bucks best bets: Giannis gets his first shot at Milwaukee

paras.en: Giannis Antetokounmpo spent 13 seasons in Milwaukee. He arrived as a teenager, left as a champion and owns most of the franchise’s important records. On Wednesday night, he sees the Bucks from the other side for the first time.
paras.zh: 扬尼斯·阿德托昆博在密尔沃基度过了 13 个赛季。他十几岁时来到这里，以冠军身份离开，并拥有球队的大部分重要记录。周三晚上，他第一次从对方的角度看到雄鹿队。

paras.en: He insists it’s "just basketball" and says "emotions are for movies." Maybe. But there’s no hiding from the storylines. Milwaukee comes to Kaseya Center with Tyler Herro, Jaime Jaquez Jr., Kel’el Ware and Kasparas Jakucionis, four former Heat first-round picks. Miami is planning a tribute video for Herro. Both sides have reasons to circle this one.
paras.zh: 他坚称这“只是篮球”，并说“情感是为了电影”。或许。但故事情节是无法隐藏的。密尔沃基队带着泰勒·赫罗、小杰米·贾克斯、凯尔·韦尔和卡斯帕拉斯·雅库西奥尼斯来到卡塞亚中心，这四名前热火首轮新秀。迈阿密正在计划为赫罗制作一个致敬视频。双方都有理由圈出这一点。

paras.en: From a betting standpoint, though, the story isn’t about Giannis’s emotions. It’s about the gap between these two teams, and where the market is pricing that gap correctly and where it isn’t.
paras.zh: 不过，从博彩的角度来看，这个故事与扬尼斯的情感无关。这是关于这两支球队之间的差距，以及市场对这种差距的定价是否正确。

paras.en: Wednesday, Nov. 18, 7 p.m. ET, Kaseya Center, Miami, ESPN. Odds via FanDuel.
paras.zh: 11 月 18 日星期三晚上 7 点东部时间，迈阿密卡塞亚中心，ESPN。通过 FanDuel 获得的赔率。

paras.en: Miami opened the season 0-4. Since then, the Heat are 8-2, they’ve won five straight, and they’re fourth in the East. Over their last 10 games, they’re averaging 123.5 points on 48.8% shooting with 31.7 assists per game.
paras.zh: 迈阿密热火以0-4开局。此后，热火取得8胜2负的战绩，取得五连胜，排名东部第四。在过去的 10 场比赛中，他们场均得到 123.5 分，命中率 48.8%，助攻 31.7 次。

paras.en: Milwaukee is 1-13 and has lost 10 in a row. During the streak, the Bucks are averaging 101.9 points on 40.9% shooting while giving up 118.7. They’re 0-6 on the road and 1-11 against teams over .500. On Sunday, they led Atlanta by 22 in the first quarter, scored 16 points in the second and lost by seven.
paras.zh: 密尔沃基队目前战绩为1胜13负，已经遭遇10连败。在此期间，雄鹿队场均得到101.9分，投篮命中率为40.9%，投篮命中率为118.7分。他们客场战绩为 0 胜 6 负，对阵 0.500 以上的球队则战绩为 1 胜 11 负。周日，他们在第一节领先亚特兰大22分，第二节拿下16分，但输掉了7分。

paras.en: That’s a team that falls apart under pressure, and Miami is very good at applying it.
paras.zh: 这是一支在压力下崩溃的球队，而迈阿密非常擅长运用这一点。

paras.en: I’m skipping the spread. Miami is just 5-9 against the spread this season, and Milwaukee is 3-2 as an underdog of 12.5 points or more. Big numbers like this make it easy for a bad team to sneak in a late cover.
paras.zh: 我正在跳过传播。迈阿密热火队本赛季的战绩仅为 5 胜 9 负，而密尔沃基队的战绩为 3 胜 2 负，落后 12.5 分或更多。像这样的大数据让一支糟糕的球队很容易在最后时刻潜入。

paras.en: The Heat’s scoring is a cleaner bet. Miami has topped 128 points in each of its last three games, against Detroit and Houston, both top-10 scoring defenses, and Cleveland. The Heat average 119.4 points per game, third in the NBA, and they rank fourth in possessions per game.
paras.zh: 热火队的得分是一个更干净的赌注。迈阿密在过去三场比赛中每场都得分超过 128 分，分别对阵底特律和休斯顿这两个防守得分排名前十的球队以及克利夫兰。热火队场均得分119.4分，位居NBA第三，场均控球率排名第四。

paras.en: Milwaukee allows 119.7 points per game, bottom-five in the league. The Heat’s over is also 4-0 in their last four home games.
paras.zh: 密尔沃基队场均失分 119.7 分，排在联盟倒数第五位。热火队最近四场主场比赛也是以 4-0 获胜。

paras.en: The one counterpoint is that the Bucks have held eight straight opponents to 123 or fewer. But none of those opponents was this Heat offense, at home, with Giannis on the floor.
paras.zh: 与之相反的是，雄鹿队已经连续八次将对手的得分限制在 123 分或更少。但这些对手都不是热火的进攻，在主场，字母哥在场上。

paras.en: Giannis Antetokounmpo under 30.5 points (-121)
paras.zh: 扬尼斯·阿德托昆博低于 30.5 分 (-121)

paras.en: This is the bet most people will get wrong.
paras.zh: 这是大多数人都会犯错的赌注。

paras.en: The emotional pick is the over. Giannis was named East Player of the Week after averaging 33.7 points, 11.3 rebounds and shooting 69% over three games. Revenge narrative, best player on the floor, easy over.
paras.zh: 情感选择已经结束。扬尼斯在三场比赛中场均得到 33.7 分、11.3 个篮板和 69% 的投篮命中率，被评为东部周最佳球员。复仇叙事，场上最好的球员，轻松结束。

paras.en: But look at what happened Monday. Miami beat Houston 128-110, and Giannis played 28 minutes. He finished with 20 points, 13 rebounds and three blocks, and sat the entire fourth quarter. When the Heat build a lead, Erik Spoelstra protects his star.
paras.zh: 但看看周一发生的事情。迈阿密以128-110击败休斯顿，字母哥打了28分钟。他全场拿下20分、13个篮板和3次盖帽，并打满了第四节。当热火取得领先时，埃里克·斯波尔斯特拉保护了他的球星。

paras.en: A 12.5-point spread says this one could get out of hand. If Miami controls the game the way the numbers suggest, Giannis is watching the fourth quarter from the bench again. One projection model puts him at 27.5 points, three below this line.
paras.zh: 12.5 点的利差表明这可能会失控。如果迈阿密按照数据显示的方式控制比赛，那么扬尼斯将再次坐在替补席上观看第四节。一种预测模型显示他的得分为 27.5 分，比这条线低了 3 分。

paras.en: The public will be betting the storyline. I’m betting the minutes.
paras.zh: 公众将押注故事情节。我赌的是分钟。

paras.en: Herro gets his own homecoming, complete with a tribute video. He’s averaging 20.3 points, already below this line, and the team around him is in free fall.
paras.zh: 赫罗迎来了自己的返校节，并附上了致敬视频。他场均得到 20.3 分，已经低于这条线，而他周围的球队正处于自由落体状态。

paras.en: Milwaukee is shooting 40.9% during its 10-game losing streak, and Herro is a big part of that. He went 2-of-13 from the field against Atlanta on Sunday. Projections have him around 20 points tonight, and his three-point prop of 2.5 is drawing under action, too.
paras.zh: 密尔沃基在10连败期间的投篮命中率为40.9%，赫罗是其中的重要组成部分。周日对阵亚特兰大的比赛中，他13投2中。预计他今晚能得到 20 分左右，而他 2.5 分的三分命中率也正在发挥作用。

paras.en: Former players often press in their first game back, and Herro is the focal point of everything Miami’s defense will be selling out to stop. I’ll take the under.
paras.zh: 前球员经常在回归后的第一场比赛中施压，而赫罗是迈阿密防守的焦点，他们将竭尽全力阻止比赛。我会拿下面的。

paras.en: The Heat are rolling, the Bucks are sinking, and that gap shows up most clearly in Miami’s scoring. Take the Heat team total, then fade the two biggest storylines in the building.
paras.zh: 热火队正在崛起，雄鹿队正在下沉，这种差距在迈阿密队的得分上表现得最为明显。以热火队的总比分为例，然后淡化大楼里两个最大的故事情节。

paras.en: Give me the Heat team total over 124.5 (-110), Giannis under 30.5 points (-121) and Herro under 21.5 points (-105).

articles.title: China watchdog warns Trump faces ‘2-on-1’ showdown with Xi, Putin as Taiwan risks mount

paras.en: President Donald Trump faces a potentially dangerous "two versus one" negotiating scenario when he meets with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin, two senior members of a congressional China watchdog warned Wednesday, raising concerns that Beijing could seek concessions on Taiwan while Moscow pushes for greater U.S. pressure on Ukraine.
paras.zh: 美国国会中国监管机构的两名高级成员周三警告说，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在会见中国国家主席习近平和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京时面临着潜在危险的“二对一”谈判局面，引发了人们的担忧，即北京可能会在台湾问题上寻求让步，而莫斯科则推动美国对乌克兰施加更大压力。

paras.en: "I think it is two versus one. We have China and China's junior partner, Russia," Randell Schriver, chairman of the U.S.-China Economic and Security Review Commission, told Fox News Digital in a Zoom interview. "Largely they come to the table as a team versus President Trump and the United States," he said, citing China's support for Russia's war in Ukraine.
paras.zh: 美中经济与安全审查委员会主席兰德尔·施赖弗在接受福克斯新闻数字频道采访时表示：“我认为这是二对一。我们有中国和中国的初级伙伴俄罗斯。”他说：“很大程度上，他们是作为一个团队来与特朗普总统和美国对抗的。”他援引了中国对俄罗斯乌克兰战争的支持。

paras.en: The warning comes ahead of Thursday's planned trilateral meeting in Shenzhen, China, on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit. The high-stakes talks are expected to address issues including the wars in Ukraine and Iran, trade and nuclear weapons.
paras.zh: 这一警告是在周四亚太经济合作组织峰会期间在中国深圳举行的三边会议之前发出的。此次高风险会谈预计将讨论乌克兰和伊朗战争、贸易和核武器等问题。

paras.en: Mike Kuiken, the commission's vice chairman, echoed Schriver's assessment, arguing that Moscow's growing dependence on Beijing puts Trump at a disadvantage.
paras.zh: 该委员会副主席迈克·库伊肯（Mike Kuiken）赞同施里弗的评估，认为莫斯科对北京日益增长的依赖使特朗普处于不利地位。

paras.en: "Putin is a client state of Xi Jinping, and that essentially means that President Trump is in the room with a two against one scenario, and the stakes are significant," Kuiken told Fox News Digital.
paras.zh: 库伊肯对福克斯新闻数字频道表示：“普京是习近平的附庸国，这本质上意味着特朗普总统正在面临二对一的局面，而且赌注很大。”

paras.en: "China is fueling Russia's war machine in Ukraine, and they are basically the lifeblood of the Russian economy at this point," he added.
paras.zh: “中国正在为俄罗斯在乌克兰的战争机器提供燃料，目前它们基本上是俄罗斯经济的命脉，”他补充道。

paras.en: The commissioners spoke as the bipartisan body released its 2026 annual report to Congress, detailing Beijing's expanding military, technological and economic capabilities and the growing challenges they pose to American national security.
paras.zh: 委员们在这个两党机构向国会发布 2026 年年度报告时发表了讲话，详细介绍了北京不断扩大的军事、技术和经济能力，以及它们对美国国家安全构成的日益严峻的挑战。

paras.en: Asked what would constitute success or failure at the summit, Kuiken suggested Beijing would not have agreed to the meeting without assurances that its interests would be protected.
paras.zh: 当被问及峰会的成功或失败是什么时，奎肯表示，如果不能保证其利益得到保护，北京不会同意这次会议。

paras.en: "My assessment is that the Chinese would never have agreed to this meeting if they had not had significant assurances that essentially nothing would happen," Kuiken said.
paras.zh: 库伊肯说：“我的评估是，如果中国没有得到基本上不会发生任何事情的重大保证，他们永远不会同意这次会议。”

paras.en: Schriver warned that both Xi and Putin would seek opportunities to advance their strategic objectives. He suggested Beijing would pursue gains related to Taiwan, while Moscow would hope Trump emerged from the meeting prepared to increase pressure on Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy.
paras.zh: 施里弗警告说，习近平和普京都将寻求机会推进其战略目标。他暗示北京将追求与台湾有关的利益，而莫斯科则希望特朗普在会议上准备好向乌克兰总统泽连斯基加大压力。

paras.en: "If Putin had his way, Trump would emerge from the meeting and put more pressure on Zelensky," Schriver said.
paras.zh: 施里弗说：“如果普京如愿，特朗普就会从会议中脱颖而出，并向泽连斯基施加更大压力。”

paras.en: He also questioned whether sufficient diplomatic groundwork had been laid for meaningful nuclear arms control discussions, one of the issues Trump has indicated he wants to address.
paras.zh: 他还质疑是否为有意义的核军备控制讨论奠定了足够的外交基础，这是特朗普表示他想解决的问题之一。

paras.en: "President Trump would like to talk about nuclear disarmament, probably an agenda that makes sense. I'm just not sure we've done the front-end work when it comes to Interagency work, bilateral or trilateral work at a lower level to have a productive discussion there," Schriver said.
paras.zh: “特朗普总统想谈论核裁军，这可能是一个有意义的议程。我只是不确定我们是否已经完成了机构间工作、较低级别的双边或三边工作的前端工作，以便在那里进行富有成效的讨论，”施里弗说。

paras.en: Nevertheless, Schriver suggested that avoiding concessions could itself represent a successful outcome for Washington.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，施赖弗表示，避免让步本身就可以代表华盛顿的成功结果。

paras.en: "I think holding ground and just a restatement of U.S. interests is probably a victory of sorts for us," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“我认为坚守阵地并重申美国的利益对我们来说可能是某种胜利。”

paras.en: Beyond the summit, the commissioners warned that the United States faces mounting challenges as China approaches 2027, the benchmark year associated with Xi's directive for the People's Liberation Army to develop the capability to conduct a Taiwan military operation.
paras.zh: 峰会之外，委员们警告说，随着中国2027年的临近，美国面临着越来越大的挑战，2027年是习近平指示中国人民解放军发展对台军事行动能力的基准年。

paras.en: Asked whether Washington was doing enough to deter Chinese military action against the self-governing island, Schriver gave a blunt assessment.
paras.zh: 当被问及华盛顿是否采取了足够措施阻止中国对这个自治岛屿采取军事行动时，施里弗给出了直言不讳的评价。

paras.en: "I think the short answer is no, we're not doing enough," he said.
paras.zh: “我认为简短的答案是否定的，我们做得还不够，”他说。

paras.en: Schriver pointed to a pause in congressional notifications for U.S. arms sales to Taiwan, saying the commission wants those notifications to proceed and supports stronger security assistance for the island.
paras.zh: 施里弗指出，国会暂停了美国对台军售通知，称该委员会希望继续进行这些通知，并支持对台湾提供更强有力的安全援助。

paras.en: He also warned that Beijing's increasingly sophisticated coercion tactics extend beyond conventional military operations to include actions involving its coast guard.
paras.zh: 他还警告说，北京日益复杂的胁迫策略超出了常规军事行动，还包括涉及其海岸警卫队的行动。

paras.en: "We do talk about counter coercion capabilities and blending not only military capabilities but law enforcement that the Chinese are doing, this sort of blended lawfare with their coast guard east of Taiwan," Schriver said.
paras.zh: 施里弗说：“我们确实谈论反胁迫能力，不仅将军事能力与中国正在进行的执法能力相结合，这种与台湾东部海岸警卫队的执法相结合。”

paras.en: "It's a tough challenge as we're entering the benchmark year that Xi Jinping said of 2027. There should be more attention to this and there should be greater efforts to this."
paras.zh: “进入习近平所说的2027年的标杆年，这是一个严峻的挑战。对此应该更加重视，应该做出更大的努力。”

paras.en: Kuiken emphasized Taiwan's importance to the global technology supply chain, particularly its role in manufacturing advanced semiconductors used in artificial intelligence.
paras.zh: 奎肯强调了台湾对全球技术供应链的重要性，特别是其在制造用于人工智能的先进半导体方面的作用。

paras.en: "Taiwan is the island at the center of the world. Xi Jinping is obsessed with it," he said.
paras.zh: “台湾是世界中心的岛屿。习近平对它很着迷，”他说。

paras.en: Pointing to Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company, or TSMC, Kuiken warned of the broader implications for American technological leadership if Beijing were to take military action against the island.
paras.zh: 库伊肯在谈到台积电时警告称，如果北京对台湾采取军事行动，美国的技术领先地位将受到更广泛的影响。

paras.en: He urged Washington and its partners to develop a coordinated strategy to make an invasion or other Chinese coercive measures against Taiwan unattractive to Beijing.
paras.zh: 他敦促华盛顿及其合作伙伴制定协调一致的战略，使中国对台湾的入侵或其他强制性措施对北京失去吸引力。

paras.en: Responding to concerns about Taiwan, a U.S. official told Fox News Digital that "There is no change to our policy with respect to Taiwan." Asked about the commissioners’ warnings, a White House official emphasized President Trump’s diplomatic approach to China and his plans to discuss nuclear arms reduction during the trilateral summit.
paras.zh: 在回应对台湾的担忧时，一名美国官员告诉福克斯新闻数字频道，“我们对台湾的政策没有改变”。当被问及委员们的警告时，一名白宫官员强调了特朗普总统对中国的外交态度以及他在三边峰会期间讨论削减核武器的计划。

paras.en: "Under President Trump’s leadership, U.S.-China relations have been refocused on what matters most – rebuilding the safety, security, and prosperity of Americans. And as President Trump has said: much has been, and will be, accomplished, between the two leaders," the official said.
paras.zh: 这位官员表示：“在特朗普总统的领导下，美中关系重新聚焦于最重要的事情上——重建美国人的安全和繁荣。正如特朗普总统所说：两位领导人之间已经取得并将取得很多成就。”

paras.en: "President Trump will conclude his visit to China with a trilateral meeting between the President of the United States, the President of the People’s Republic of China, and the President of the Russian Federation."
paras.zh: “特朗普总统将通过美国总统、中华人民共和国主席和俄罗斯联邦总统之间的三边会晤来结束对中国的访问。”

paras.en: "The President has made it clear that, among other topics, he will discuss the reduction of nuclear weapons in the world, whose proliferation President Trump believes is very dangerous," the official added.
paras.zh: 这位官员补充道：“总统已明确表示，除其他议题外，他将讨论世界范围内核武器的削减，特朗普总统认为核武器的扩散非常危险。”

paras.en: The commissioners also raised alarm about China's rapidly expanding capabilities beneath the ocean, warning that Beijing could threaten the communications infrastructure on which the United States and its allies depend.
paras.zh: 委员们还对中国迅速扩张的海底能力发出警告，警告北京可能威胁到美国及其盟国所依赖的通信基础设施。

paras.en: Asked whether China could disrupt critical American communications during a conflict, Kuiken was unequivocal. "Simple answer is absolutely yes," he said.
paras.zh: 当被问及中国是否会在冲突期间扰乱美国的关键通讯时，库伊肯毫不含糊。 “简单的答案是绝对肯定的，”他说。

paras.en: "The Chinese have spent a long time studying the global communications network and they have absolutely developed the capabilities to sever undersea cables around the globe."
paras.zh: “中国人花了很长时间研究全球通信网络，他们绝对已经具备了切断全球海底电缆的能力。”

paras.en: Kuiken said he was confident China had probably conducted exercises involving such operations, although he did not identify specific exercises during the interview.
paras.zh: 库伊肯表示，他相信中国可能进行了涉及此类行动的演习，但他在采访中没有透露具体演习内容。

paras.en: Schriver pointed to China's advances in undersea warfare and ocean mapping as among the most concerning developments identified in the commission's research.
paras.zh: 施赖弗指出，中国在水下作战和海洋测绘方面取得的进步是该委员会研究中最令人担忧的进展之一。

paras.en: He said the commission is urging Congress to strengthen protection of undersea communications cables through improved real-time threat detection, rapid repair capabilities and greater coordination with U.S. allies.
paras.zh: 他说，该委员会敦促国会通过改进实时威胁检测、快速修复能力以及加强与美国盟友的协调来加强对海底通信电缆的保护。

paras.en: "So you need to be able to understand in real time when there's a threat to those communication cables," Schriver said.
paras.zh: “因此，您需要能够实时了解这些通信电缆何时受到威胁，”施里弗说。

paras.en: The commission has separately warned that cables linking the United States with Taiwan, Japan and the Philippines are vulnerable to disruption, with damage potentially forcing communications onto slower and less direct routes.
paras.zh: 该委员会还单独警告称，连接美国与台湾、日本和菲律宾的电缆很容易受到干扰，损坏可能会迫使通信走上速度较慢且不那么直接的路线。

paras.en: The broader concern, Kuiken suggested, is the cumulative effect of China's sustained investment in science and technology at a time when American innovation faces growing competitive pressure.
paras.zh: 库伊肯表示，更广泛的担忧是，在美国创新面临越来越大的竞争压力之际，中国对科技的持续投资所产生的累积效应。

paras.en: "I think what we are seeing is that the Chinese are starting to turn science, engineering and artificial intelligence into economic strength, national security and global influence," he said.
paras.zh: “我认为我们看到的是中国人开始将科学、工程和人工智能转化为经济实力、国家安全和全球影响力，”他说。

paras.en: For the two commissioners, those developments underscore the stakes of Trump's meeting with Xi and Putin: Washington faces not only an immediate diplomatic challenge but a longer-term competition with a Chinese leadership steadily building the capabilities to challenge American power.
paras.zh: 对于两位委员来说，这些事态发展凸显了特朗普与习近平和普京会面的利害关系：华盛顿不仅面临着眼前的外交挑战，而且还面临着与中国领导层的长期竞争，中国领导层正在稳步建立挑战美国实力的能力。

paras.en: The Chinese Embassy in Washington did not respond to Fox News Digital’s request for comment in time for publication.
paras.zh: 中国驻华盛顿大使馆没有及时回应福克斯新闻数字媒体的置评请求。

articles.title: Trump holds the nuclear cards to play against China and Russia on arms control

paras.en: Nuclear weapons aren’t usually a topic at APEC, but trilateral arms control has been on the mind of President Donald J. Trump since at least last spring. And after launching Operation Epic Fury to end Iran’s path to a nuclear weapon, no one can doubt Trump is serious about the nuclear menace.
paras.zh: 核武器通常不是亚太经合组织的主题，但至少从去年春天以来，三边军备控制一直是唐纳德·J·特朗普总统考虑的问题。在发起史诗般的愤怒行动以结束伊朗的核武器之路之后，没有人可以怀疑特朗普对核威胁的认真态度。

paras.en: What better moment than this historic trilateral meeting between Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin?
paras.zh: 还有什么比特朗普、中国国家主席习近平和俄罗斯总统普京之间的历史性三边会晤更好的时刻呢？

paras.en: Turns out China is also a growing nuclear problem. Driven by Xi Jinping’s ambitions, China has doubled its arsenal from 300 nuclear warheads in 2020 to over 600 today. American policymakers have little visibility into China’s intentions. And of course, the last nuclear arms control treaty with Russia, called New START, expired on Feb. 5.
paras.zh: 事实证明，中国的核问题也日益严重。在习近平雄心的推动下，中国的核弹头数量增加了一倍，从2020年的300枚增加到如今的600多枚。美国决策者对中国的意图知之甚少。当然，与俄罗斯签订的最后一项核武器控制条约《新削减战略武器条约》已于 2 月 5 日到期。

paras.en: Trump raised trilateral arms control during his May trip to Beijing, and again during Xi’s visit to Washington. "The President advocated for trilateral arms control negotiations" among the three countries, the White House statement said on Sept. 24.
paras.zh: 特朗普在五月北京之行和习近平访问华盛顿期间再次提出了三边军备控制。白宫9月24日的声明称，“总统主张在这三个国家之间进行三边军控谈判”。

paras.en: No U.S. president has ever tried to coax China into nuclear arms control. It’s a monumental task, but perhaps the moment is now.
paras.zh: 没有一位美国总统试图诱骗中国进行核军备控制。这是一项艰巨的任务，但也许现在就是时候了。

paras.en: The Pentagon estimates China’s arsenal will reach 1,000 warheads by 2030 and continue to 1,500. Last year, China paraded its new JL-3 submarine-launched ballistic missile with a range of 5,400 miles, meaning Chinese submarines can launch nuclear weapons from littoral waters to hit U.S. targets. Don’t forget China’s H-6N bomber with its air-launched nuclear cruise missiles, and of course, China’s fractional orbital bombardment system, which in theory can put a nuclear hypersonic warhead into low Earth orbit. Then there is North Korea, which has developed its nuclear arsenal with help from both Russia and China.
paras.zh: 五角大楼估计，到 2030 年，中国的核武库将达到 1,000 枚弹头，并将继续保持在 1,500 枚。去年，中国展示了新型JL-3潜射弹道导弹，射程为5,400英里，这意味着中国潜艇可以从沿海水域发射核武器打击美国目标。不要忘记中国的H-6N轰炸机及其空射核巡航导弹，当然还有中国的分数轨道轰炸系统，理论上可以将核高超音速弹头送入近地轨道。然后是朝鲜，它在俄罗斯和中国的帮助下发展了核武库。

paras.en: You can see why Trump wants to "discuss the reduction of nuclear weapons in the world," which President Trump believes are very dangerous, White House spokesperson Olivia Wales said.
paras.zh: 白宫发言人奥利维亚·威尔士表示，你可以明白为什么特朗普想要“讨论世界范围内的核武器削减”，特朗普总统认为这非常危险。

paras.en: Those dictators crave the optics. Maybe Trump can leverage the limelight. The trilateral summit won’t produce a treaty, but it might start a conversation. Here’s why.
paras.zh: 那些独裁者渴望光学。也许特朗普可以利用聚光灯。三边峰会不会达成条约，但可能会开始对话。原因如下。

paras.en: Over the past year, America’s geopolitical power has increased. The U.S.-China trade deficit is at its lowest level in 20 years. America is ahead in AI "superintelligence." Russia, on the other hand, is becoming an economic vassal state to China and a target of Ukraine’s long-range drone strikes on energy and military targets. In China, President Xi Jinping has carried out so many leadership purges that the powerful Central Military Commission is down to just two of its seven members.
paras.zh: 过去一年，美国的地缘政治实力有所增强。美中贸易逆差处于20年来的最低水平。美国在人工智能“超级智能”方面处于领先地位。另一方面，俄罗斯正在成为中国的经济附庸国，也是乌克兰对能源和军事目标进行远程无人机袭击的目标。在中国，习近平主席进行了多次领导层清洗，强大的中央军事委员会只剩下七名委员中的两名。

paras.en: Despite the midterms, President Trump has momentum due in part to his military buildup. Don’t forget President Ronald Reagan notched big successes such as the 1987 Intermediate-Range Nuclear Forces, or INF, Treaty, which eliminated an entire class of U.S. and Soviet nuclear weapons after control of Congress switched to the Democrats.
paras.zh: 尽管正在进行中期选举，特朗普总统的势头依然强劲，部分原因在于他的军事建设。不要忘记罗纳德·里根总统取得了巨大成功，例如 1987 年《中程核力量条约》，该条约在国会控制权转向民主党后消除了美国和苏联的一整类核武器。

paras.en: And whatever Xi and Putin have to say in Shenzhen, America’s modernized triad remains the single most powerful bargaining chip for any future arms control. Here are the three key programs.
paras.zh: 无论习近平和普京在深圳说什么，美国的现代化黑社会仍然是未来军备控制的最有力的筹码。以下是三个关键程序。

paras.en: Sentinel nuclear missile. Look for the first test flight of the new Sentinel intercontinental ballistic missile, or ICBM, in 2027. The LGM-35 Sentinel missile will replace the 1970s-era Minuteman III missiles as the land-based missile leg of the triad. In wartime, ICBMs can hit targets about 30 minutes after launch. Sentinel completed a stacking test in September, with all missile components loaded into the cavernous launch silo at Vandenberg Space Force Base on the California coast. Over time, about 400 Sentinel missiles will be deployed in new silos across the missile fields of Montana, North Dakota and Wyoming.
paras.zh: 哨兵核导弹。预计新型哨兵洲际弹道导弹（ICBM）将于 2027 年进行首次试飞。LGM-35 哨兵导弹将取代 1970 年代的民兵 III 导弹，成为三合会的陆基导弹支柱。战时，洲际弹道导弹发射后约30分钟即可击中目标。 “哨兵”号于 9 月完成了一次堆叠测试，所有导弹部件均装入加州海岸范登堡太空部队基地的海绵状发射井中。随着时间的推移，大约 400 枚哨兵导弹将部署在蒙大拿州、北达科他州和怀俄明州导弹领域的新发射井中。

paras.en: B-21 Raider stealth bomber. Today, a fleet of 76 B-52s and just 20 B-2 Spirit stealth bombers — of Midnight Hammer fame — comprises the air-delivered leg of the triad. The B-21 Raider is a sleek, gray stealth bomber that will join the triad soon. On Nov. 13, the B-21 completed its first weapons release on the test range, and plans call for accelerated production.
paras.zh: B-21 Raider 隐形轰炸机。如今，一支由 76 架 B-52 和仅 20 架 B-2 Spirit 隐形轰炸机（因“午夜之锤”而闻名）组成的机队构成了三合会的空投部分。 B-21 Raider 是一款时尚的灰色隐形轰炸机，很快将加入三合会。 11 月 13 日，B-21 在试验场完成了首次武器投放，并计划加快生产。

paras.en: Columbia-class submarine. I saw the bow section of the 520-foot hull of the USS District of Columbia at the shipyard, and this new ballistic missile submarine is huge. The shipyards doubled their work output over the summer, bringing this lead submarine back on track for delivery in 2028, according to Rear Adm. Rob Gaucher, the U.S. Navy’s direct report program manager for undersea warfare. Eventually, 12 Columbia-class submarines will take over the sea-based mission of the nuclear deterrent and provide an assured second-strike capability by carrying 16 Trident II missiles apiece, each of which can be armed with up to 12 nuclear warheads.
paras.zh: 哥伦比亚级潜艇。我在造船厂看到了哥伦比亚特区号520英尺船体的船头部分，这艘新型弹道导弹潜艇非常巨大。 The shipyards doubled their work output over the summer, bringing this lead submarine back on track for delivery in 2028, according to Rear Adm. Rob Gaucher, the U.S. Navy’s direct report program manager for undersea warfare. Eventually, 12 Columbia-class submarines will take over the sea-based mission of the nuclear deterrent and provide an assured second-strike capability by carrying 16 Trident II missiles apiece, each of which can be armed with up to 12 nuclear warheads.

paras.en: Whether or not China and Russia see the light on arms reductions, a fully modernized nuclear triad will ensure America can deter nuclear war from any direction.
paras.zh: 无论中国和俄罗斯是否看到了削减军备的曙光，完全现代化的三位一体核力量将确保美国能够阻止来自任何方向的核战争。

articles.title: The leave campaign has been resurrected, so how should Burnham respond?
articles.author: Jessica Elgot Deputy political editor

paras.en: The launch of a pro-Brexit campaign was one of the few genuine surprises this week in Westminster, even if the arguments were straight out of a familiar playbook.
paras.zh: 支持脱欧运动的发起是威斯敏斯特本周为数不多的真正令人惊讶的事情之一，尽管这些论点直接出自熟悉的剧本。

paras.en: The video launched on X over the weekend, with scenes of riots in France, champagne flowing in Brussels, and European politicians saying how desperate they were for Britain’s cash.
paras.zh: 这段视频于周末在 X 上发布，视频中出现了法国骚乱、布鲁塞尔香槟流淌的场景，以及欧洲政界人士表示他们多么渴望英国的现金。

paras.en: Among Westminster’s anti-Brexit veterans, there was immediate chatter about whether a counteroffensive was needed. “I think the immediate reaction was – are they off to the races while we are still putting our pants on?” one said.
paras.zh: 在威斯敏斯特的反脱欧老兵中，立即有人议论是否需要反攻。 “我认为第一反应是——当我们还在穿裤子的时候，他们就去比赛了吗？”一个说。

paras.en: For now, the rebuttal of Stay Out’s claims – including that returning to the EU would cost £750m a week – is mostly being done on social media by interested pro-rejoin freelancers, without any kind of central organisation.
paras.zh: 目前，对《Stay Out》主张的反驳——包括重返欧盟每周将花费 7.5 亿英镑——主要是由感兴趣的支持重新加入的自由职业者在社交媒体上进行的，没有任何形式的中央组织。

paras.en: One MP said: “It is hard for us to begin any kind of new pro-rejoin campaign until we know exactly the direction the government is heading.
paras.zh: 一位议员表示：“在我们确切知道政府的前进方向之前，我们很难开始任何新的支持重新加入的运动。

paras.en: “There are organisations that exist already, like Best for Britain, but I think making the case to the public would need a fresh movement. I think we want to stay away from the kind of marches that People’s Vote movement did with the blue berets if we can possibly avoid it.”
paras.zh: “已经有一些组织存在了，比如‘Best for Britain’，但我认为向公众展示这一点需要一场新的运动。我认为，如果我们可以避免的话，我们希望远离人民投票运动戴着蓝色贝雷帽进行的那种游行。”

paras.en: Inside No 10, there is a confidence that Andy Burnham can make his own case for a closer relationship with Europe, without the need for any external pressure group. Stay Out – which is run by the former deputy chief Brexit negotiator Oliver Lewis – will be dubbed “the status quo campaign”.
paras.zh: 10 号内部人士相信，安迪·伯纳姆 (Andy Burnham) 可以提出自己的理由，与欧洲建立更密切的关系，而不需要任何外部压力集团。由前脱欧副首席谈判代表奥利弗·刘易斯领导的“留出局”将被称为“维持现状运动”。

paras.en: There is reason to be confident. Strategists have seen Labour polling that shows almost three-quarters – 71% – of all voters support a closer relationship with Europe if it helps bring down prices and grow the economy.
paras.zh: 我们有理由充满信心。策略师们看到工党民意调查显示，近四分之三（71%）的选民支持与欧洲建立更密切的关系，如果这有助于降低物价和增长经济。

paras.en: It will be the prime minister, they say, who can front any campaigning that is needed, who can argue that Brexit has done more harm than good, damaging the economy, making it harder for British people to travel and businesses to trade and fuelling the small boats crisis.
paras.zh: 他们说，只有首相才可以开展任何必要的竞选活动，才能辩称脱欧弊大于利，损害经济，使英国民众出行和企业贸易更加困难，并加剧小船危机。

paras.en: However, there will be some fears that this has been tried before when David Cameron attempted to make the case for remain in 2016. But Labour strategists say this is a fundamentally different political moment. “Cameron could not make this kind of emotional connection with people, it was business leaders, facts and figures, and he was arguing for the status quo,” one said. “We are the change campaign now.”
paras.zh: 然而，有人担心戴维·卡梅伦 (David Cameron) 2016 年试图证明留欧时曾尝试过这种做法。但工党策略师表示，这是一个根本不同的政治时刻。一位人士表示：“卡梅伦无法与人们建立这种情感联系，他是商界领袖、事实和数据，而他只是在维护现状。” “我们现在正在发起变革运动。”

paras.en: While some cabinet members urged caution last week over Burnham’s uncertain direction on Europe, most trust the prime minister can set out a viable post-summit plan. “All of us, honestly, are slightly running to catch up with a different way of doing things,” one said. “We all easily lapse into the worries about leave-voting seats.
paras.zh: 尽管一些内阁成员上周敦促人们对伯纳姆在欧洲问题上不确定的方向保持谨慎，但大多数人相信总理能够制定可行的峰会后计划。 “老实说，我们所有人都在努力追赶一种不同的做事方式，”一位人士说道。 “我们都很容易陷入对保留投票席位的担忧之中。

paras.en: “But there is obviously an argument to be made that the old rules don’t apply. And Andy’s way of doing things is laying out political argument. And we have to believe in that as the way to affect public sentiment.”
paras.zh: “但显然有人认为旧规则不适用。安迪的做事方式是提出政治论点。我们必须相信这是影响公众情绪的方式。”

paras.en: There are some close to Labour who worry about leaving the argument solely to Burnham. “Can they do this from the bowels of Downing Street?” one asked. “You do need rebuttal out there and people ready to go out and fight and say, this is bollocks. And it felt like that infrastructure is not there yet.”
paras.zh: 一些与工党关系密切的人担心将争论完全留给伯纳姆。 “他们能在唐宁街的内部做到这一点吗？”有人问道。 “你确实需要反驳，人们准备好出去战斗并说，这是胡说八道。而且感觉基础设施还没有到位。”

paras.en: Another veteran of the remain campaign said there was concern about being “left out on a limb” if a rejoin campaign was resurrected. “I think whether they like it or not, there will be an apolitical campaign trying to push the maximalist position on Europe. They have people willing to help but it’s not organised in any way.”
paras.zh: 另一位留欧运动资深人士表示，如果重新加入留欧运动，人们担心会“陷入困境”。 “我认为，无论他们喜欢与否，都会有一场非政治运动试图推动欧洲的最高主义立场。他们有人愿意提供帮助，但没有以任何方式组织起来。”

paras.en: Many of those who worked on the remain campaign and the subsequent People’s Vote are scarred by the experience, particular the final months which descended into bitter infighting. But the same is also true for some of the most high-profile veterans of Vote Leave – who also want to steer clear of Stay Out.
paras.zh: 许多参与留欧运动和随后的人民投票的人都因这段经历而伤痕累累，特别是最后几个月陷入了激烈的内讧。但对于一些最引人注目的“脱欧”退伍军人来说也是如此——他们也想避开“脱欧”。

paras.en: As in the pro-Brexit campaigns, there are often willing funders to push pro-European campaigning. “It will happen because there will be money for it,” one campaign veteran said. “But you could not pay me any money to go back to that issue.”
paras.zh: 与支持脱欧的运动一样，经常有愿意资助的人推动支持欧洲的运动。 “这将会发生，因为会有钱，”一位竞选资深人士说。 “但你不能付给我任何钱来让我回到这个问题。”

articles.title: EU ‘to close door’ to talks on long-term UK ties until Burnham has decided on Brexit
articles.author: Pippa Crerar, Lisa O’Carroll and Jessica Elgot

paras.en: The EU will shut the door to discussions with Andy Burnham about the UK’s longer-term relationship with the bloc until the government has decided whether it wants to proceed with reversing Brexit, diplomats have said.
paras.zh: 外交官表示，在英国政府决定是否继续扭转脱欧进程之前，欧盟将关闭与安迪·伯纳姆讨论英国与欧盟长期关系的大门。

paras.en: European capitals are also warning they have reached the end of the line for piecemeal “reset” summits with the UK and want the prime minister to focus on his next steps domestically before they proceed.
paras.zh: 欧洲各国政府还警告说，他们与英国零碎“重置”峰会的期限已经到了最后，并希望首相在继续之前将重点放在国内的下一步行动上。

paras.en: But they suggested a joint statement after a summit this Friday would signal that further discussions would follow on the UK’s entry to the EU’s energy single markets, irregular migration and a closer defence and security relationship.
paras.zh: 但他们表示，本周五峰会后发表的联合声明将表明，接下来将就英国进入欧盟能源单一市场、非正常移民以及更密切的国防和安全关系等问题进行进一步讨论。

paras.en: “Clarity is what we need more than anything from the UK. Don’t come back until you know what you want. Work out what your options really are and then come to negotiate,” one EU diplomat said.
paras.zh: “我们最需要英国提供的是明确性。在你知道自己想要什么之前不要回来。弄清楚你的真正选择是什么，然后进行谈判，”一位欧盟外交官表示。

paras.en: “The prime minister needs to bring the public with him. We can’t have another negotiation based on just half the country. We’ll only put the effort in if we know it’s not going to change down the line.”
paras.zh: “总理需要让公众与他一起。我们不能仅以一半的国家为基础进行另一次谈判。只有在我们知道情况不会改变的情况下，我们才会投入努力。”

paras.en: Burnham is expected to set out his own next steps after the summit on Monday, including his hopes for a “national conversation” on what a closer relationship might look like.
paras.zh: 预计伯纳姆将在周一峰会后制定自己的下一步行动，包括他希望就如何建立更密切的关系进行“全国对话”。

paras.en: With less than 48 hours before the Brussels summit, negotiators were still racing to finalise Friday’s agreement. A leaked draft seen by the Guardian shows continued disagreement over demands by the EU that the UK commit to aligning with the bloc’s trade defence measures, such as tariffs on Chinese electric vehicles, in exchange for inclusion in Made in Europe legislation.
paras.zh: 距离布鲁塞尔峰会召开还有不到 48 小时，谈判代表仍在竞相敲定周五的协议。 《卫报》看到的一份泄露的草案显示，欧盟要求英国承诺与欧盟的贸易防御措施保持一致，例如对中国电动汽车征收关税，以换取纳入“欧洲制造”立法，但双方仍存在分歧。

paras.en: The text shows the UK is pushing for a weaker commitment, only promising an “aim to protect supply chains consistently across our markets and guard against potential risks of circumvention”.
paras.zh: 文本显示，英国正在推动较弱的承诺，仅承诺“旨在持续保护整个市场的供应链并防范潜在的规避风险”。

paras.en: A Cabinet Office source said Made in Europe language was “the highest jeopardy” in the negotiations, while an EU official suggested it was the part of the discussions most likely to go “down to the wire” on Friday.
paras.zh: 一位内阁办公室消息人士称，“欧洲制造”的语言是谈判中“最危险的”，而一位欧盟官员则表示，这是最有可能在周五“进入最后阶段”的讨论的一部分。

paras.en: Though there is a formal commitment to annual reset summits, senior EU diplomats say the current approach, designed by Keir Starmer, will quickly “reach its limits” and more “mini deals” do not make sense.
paras.zh: 尽管对年度重置峰会做出了正式承诺，但欧盟高级外交官表示，由凯尔·斯塔默设计的当前方法将很快“达到极限”，更多“小型协议”没有意义。

paras.en: One said the “piecemeal approach is coming to an end” and that Burnham’s intentions for the UK’s long-term relationship created a natural juncture for the EU too.
paras.zh: 一位人士表示，“零敲碎打的做法即将结束”，伯纳姆对英国长期关系的意图也为欧盟创造了一个自然契机。

paras.en: Another said: “It is like a buffet: you can choose to nibble on one or two dishes to start, but at a certain point you have to go for the whole of the buffet.”
paras.zh: 另一个人说：“这就像自助餐：你可以选择先吃一两道菜，但到了某个时候你就必须吃掉整个自助餐了。”

paras.en: One EU diplomat said there would be a “pause for reflection” after the Friday summit.
paras.zh: 一位欧盟外交官表示，周五峰会后将“暂停反思”。

paras.en: Burnham has said there is no rush to decide on the longer-term relationship, as he comes under pressure from within his own party to slow the pace of pursuing of closer ties.
paras.zh: 伯纳姆表示，并不急于就长期关系做出决定，因为他面临党内要求放慢追求更紧密关系步伐的压力。

paras.en: He is not now expected to set out the full range of options for the future relationship – the status quo, customs union, single market or full rejoin – until he announces his 10-year plan in December.
paras.zh: 目前预计他不会为未来关系提出全部选择——维持现状、关税同盟、单一市场或全面重新加入——直到他在 12 月宣布他的十年计划。

paras.en: Sources said the government was considering holding a year-long “national conversation” in 2027, including town halls and citizens assemblies, before deciding which route to pursue in advance of the next election.
paras.zh: 消息人士称，政府正在考虑在 2027 年举行为期一年的“全国对话”，包括市政厅和公民大会，然后再决定在下次选举之前采取哪条路线。

paras.en: However, the potential length of that debate has alarmed Brussels officials, who were caught off-guard by the launch of the new pro-Brexit campaign group Stay Out, set up by architects of the Vote Leave campaign.
paras.zh: 然而，这场辩论可能会持续很长的时间，这让布鲁塞尔官员感到震惊，他们对新的支持脱欧运动组织“留出局”的发起感到措手不及，该组织是由“脱欧”运动的策划者建立的。

paras.en: One EU diplomat said: “The government would spend the year making evidence-based arguments about each of the four options, while Boris Johnson and Michael Gove and Nigel Farage will spend it shouting about traitors.”
paras.zh: 一位欧盟外交官表示：“政府将用这一年的时间对四种选择中的每一种进行基于证据的论证，而鲍里斯·约翰逊、迈克尔·戈夫和奈杰尔·法拉奇将用这一年的时间对叛徒大喊大叫。”

paras.en: After the reset deal is agreed on Friday, it will be enacted by the European partnership bill, covering the deals on food and agriculture, emissions trading and youth mobility. It is expected to be introduced before Christmas, with legislation laid possibly as soon as next week.
paras.zh: 周五就重置协议达成一致后，该协议将由欧洲伙伴关系法案颁布，涵盖粮食和农业、排放交易和青年流动方面的协议。预计将在圣诞节前推出，立法最早可能在下周制定。

paras.en: EU diplomats said the two sides were expected to settle on a quota of about 100,000 people a year being allowed to work, travel or study in each other’s territories. Originally, the UK had pitched for 50,000 and then 80,000, while Brussels has consistently sought a higher number.
paras.zh: 欧盟外交官表示，预计双方将达成每年约10万人在对方境内工作、旅行或学习的配额。最初，英国的目标是 50,000，后来是 80,000，而布鲁塞尔一直在寻求更高的数字。

paras.en: Both sides have agreed that tuition fees for European students coming to the UK should be discussed at a later date, although there have been attempts by some member states to link the debate to the ratification of the whole reset deal.
paras.zh: 双方都同意，应在晚些时候讨论欧洲学生来英国的学费问题，尽管一些成员国试图将辩论与整个重置协议的批准联系起来。

paras.en: Senior Labour figures are already beginning their push to have a full rejoining on the table. The former business secretary Peter Kyle said Burnham should fight the next election on a promise to rejoin the EU, with voters given a referendum on the outcome of any deal.
paras.zh: 工党高级官员已经开始推动全面重新加入谈判。前商务大臣彼得·凯尔表示，伯纳姆应该在下次选举中承诺重新加入欧盟，并让选民对任何协议的结果进行公投。

paras.en: Kyle, who was a key member of Starmer’s cabinet, said the “only way through” the challenges of the domestic political debate was for the government to offer voters the choice to accept or reject any agreement.
paras.zh: 斯塔默内阁的重要成员凯尔表示，应对国内政治辩论挑战的“唯一途径是政府让选民选择接受或拒绝任何协议。

paras.en: He is the latest senior Labour MP to publicly wade into the Brexit debate, after the former foreign secretary David Lammy said the party should go into the next election clear that its intention was to rejoin.
paras.zh: 在前外交大臣戴维·拉米表示，该党应该在下一次选举中明确表示其重新加入的意图之后，他是最新一位公开介入英国脱欧辩论的高级工党议员。

paras.en: Rachel Reeves, the former chancellor, has also said Britain’s future should be back in the bloc, arguing that leaving had made the UK “poorer, weaker and less secure”.
paras.zh: 前财政大臣雷切尔·里夫斯也表示，英国的未来应该回到欧盟，她认为脱欧使英国“更穷、更弱、更不安全”。

articles.title: Hegseth boasts of Maduro’s capture while vowing to deepen US military cooperation with Venezuela
articles.author: Tom Phillips Latin America correspondent

paras.en: Pete Hegseth has used his first visit to Venezuela since US special forces abducted its former president, Nicolás Maduro, to boast of the dictator’s capture during what he called “the single most sophisticated military operation in the history of Latin America”.
paras.zh: 皮特·赫格斯自美国特种部队绑架前总统尼古拉斯·马杜罗以来首次访问委内瑞拉，夸耀在他所谓的“拉丁美洲历史上最复杂的军事行动”中抓获这位独裁者。

paras.en: Maduro was controversially seized by Delta Force operatives in the early hours of 3 January, setting in motion an improbable rapprochement between Washington and Venezuela’s anti-imperialist “Chavista” regime, which has ruled since 1999.
paras.zh: 1 月 3 日凌晨，马杜罗被三角洲部队特工抓获，引发了争议，华盛顿与自 1999 年以来一直执政的委内瑞拉反帝国主义“查韦斯主义”政权之间开始了不可思议的和解。

paras.en: Speaking outside the recently reopened US embassy in Venezuela’s capital, Caracas, on Wednesday, Hegseth said: “It’s a great honor to be here as the first United States secretary of war this century to set foot in Venezuela. Just one year ago my presence here … would have been deemed impossible, almost unimaginable.
paras.zh: 周三，赫格塞斯在最近重新开放的美国驻委内瑞拉首都加拉加斯大使馆外发表讲话说：“作为本世纪首位踏足委内瑞拉的美国战争部长，我感到非常荣幸。就在一年前，我来到这里……还被认为是不可能的，几乎是不可想象的。”

paras.en: “In fact, exactly one year ago today … [Maduro] stood on a stage not too far from here and yelled mockingly, ‘Come and get me!’” Hegseth recalled, before adding sarcastically: “Well, we answered that call.
paras.zh: “事实上，就在一年前的今天……[马杜罗]站在离这里不远的舞台上，嘲笑地喊道，‘来抓我！’”赫格斯回忆道，然后讽刺地补充道：“好吧，我们响应了这个号召。

paras.en: “The reality is that … January 3 is the day that will go down in history as a day of liberation for Venezuela,” Hegseth claimed, although Maduro’s allies continue to hold power with US support.
paras.zh: 赫格斯声称，“现实是……1月3日将作为委内瑞拉的解放日载入史册”，尽管马杜罗的盟友在美国的支持下继续掌权。

paras.en: Earlier in the day, Hegseth was welcomed to the Miraflores Palace by Maduro’s former vice-president, Delcy Rodríguez, who became acting president with Donald Trump’s blessing after his abduction.
paras.zh: 当天早些时候，赫格斯在米拉弗洛雷斯宫受到马杜罗前副总统德尔西·罗德里格斯的欢迎，德尔西·罗德里格斯在赫格斯被绑架后在唐纳德·特朗普的祝福下成为代理总统。

paras.en: In the aftermath of the deadly US attack, Hegseth was one of the bluntest Trump administration voices when it came to celebrating the invasion. “Maduro had his chance … he effed around and he found out,” the defense secretary bragged.
paras.zh: 在美国致命袭击事件发生后，赫格斯是特朗普政府在庆祝入侵方面最直言不讳的人之一。 “马杜罗有他的机会……他四处奔走，然后他发现了，”国防部长吹嘘道。

paras.en: Speaking at the palace, Hegseth struck a more conciliatory tone as he vowed to deepen cooperation with Venezuela’s new leaders in brief comments that were broadcast by the state broadcaster VTV.
paras.zh: 赫格塞斯在宫殿发表讲话时语气更加和解，他在国家广播公司 VTV 播出的简短评论中誓言要深化与委内瑞拉新领导人的合作。

paras.en: “I stand here on behalf of President Trump, who sends his greeting and looks forward to the opportunities, not just militarily … but also economically: the incredible resource capabilities that your country has, that we look forward to unlocking together with you,” Hegseth told Rodríguez and senior cabinet members, including the defense and foreign ministers, Gustavo González López and Oliver Blanco.
paras.zh: “我代表特朗普总统站在这里，他向我致以问候，并期待着机会，不仅是军事上的......而且还有经济上的机会：你们国家拥有令人难以置信的资源能力，我们期待与你们一起释放，”赫格斯告诉罗德里格斯和包括国防部长和外交部长古斯塔沃·冈萨雷斯·洛佩斯和奥利弗·布兰科在内的高级内阁成员。

paras.en: Hegseth said his visit to Rodríguez’s “beautiful country” was designed to re-establish and increase “defense cooperation” between “two great militaries” that less than a year ago were briefly at war. Earlier this month, the New York Times reported that Trump officials were trying to negotiate a long-term US troop presence in Venezuela as part of their push for regional hegemony.
paras.zh: 赫格塞斯表示，他对罗德里格斯“美丽的国家”的访问旨在重建和加强不到一年前还短暂交战的“两支伟大军队”之间的“防务合作”。本月早些时候，《纽约时报》报道称，特朗普官员正试图就美国在委内瑞拉的长期驻军问题进行谈判，作为推动地区霸权的一部分。

paras.en: “I appreciate your leadership and commitment to your country,” Hegseth told Maduro’s successor, a once outspoken anti-imperialist leftist who has overseen an unlikely realignment with Washington since her ally was grabbed.
paras.zh: “我感谢你的领导力和对国家的承诺，”赫格赛斯对马杜罗的继任者说。这位曾经直言不讳的反帝国主义左派人士，自从她的盟友被抓之后，她就监督了与华盛顿不太可能的重新结盟。

paras.en: During her five-minute address, Rodríguez, whose oil-rich country is widely seen to have become a US protectorate after January’s invasion, made no mention of Maduro, who is behind bars in New York City.
paras.zh: 人们普遍认为，罗德里格斯的石油资源丰富的国家在一月份的入侵后已成为美国的保护国，在她五分钟的讲话中，罗德里格斯没有提及目前关押在纽约市监狱中的马杜罗。

paras.en: But referring indirectly to his capture and the subsequent reconciliation with Washington, she told Hegseth: “Thanks to the political and geopolitical maturity of our governments, we have – in a very short period of time, just a few months – turned what were very difficult and very tough times for our people, into an extraordinary space for cooperation and mutual benefit.”
paras.zh: 但她间接提到他的被捕以及随后与华盛顿的和解，她告诉赫格塞斯：“由于我们各国政府在政治和地缘政治上的成熟，我们在很短的时间内，短短几个月内，将我们人民非常困难和艰难的时期转变为合作和互利的非凡空间。”

paras.en: Rodríguez hailed the “historic” energy deal her government recently struck with Trump, who has called it “the biggest oil deal in world history” as well as “the spoils” of his “conquest” of Venezuela.
paras.zh: 罗德里格斯赞扬了她的政府最近与特朗普达成的“历史性”能源协议，特朗普称其为“世界历史上最大的石油协议”以及他“征服”委内瑞拉的“战利品”。

paras.en: Hegseth claimed the agreement, which reportedly involves 65bn barrels of reserves, “makes the strait of Hormuz a non-factor for the western hemisphere”.
paras.zh: 赫格塞斯声称，该协议据报道涉及650亿桶储量，它“使霍尔木兹海峡对西半球来说不再是一个因素”。

paras.en: Critics of Rodríguez’s political movement painted Hegseth’s visit as a humiliating act of genuflection for a president with no choice but to roll out the red carpet for the man whose troops captured her boss.
paras.zh: 罗德里格斯政治运动的批评者将赫格塞斯的访问描绘成一位总统的屈辱性屈膝行为，总统别无选择，只能为他的军队抓获了她老板的人铺上红地毯。

paras.en: Writing on X, Luz Mely Reyes, a prominent Venezuelan journalist, said Hegseth’s visit was designed to underscore Washington’s “direct administration” of her country.
paras.zh: 委内瑞拉著名记者卢兹·梅利·雷耶斯 (Luz Mely Reyes) 在 X 上撰文表示，赫格塞斯的访问旨在强调华盛顿对委内瑞拉的“直接管理”。

paras.en: “Ten months after Nicolás Maduro’s capture, Washington no longer needs to fire shots to remind everyone who is in charge: the mere presence on Venezuelan soil of the architect of the January incursion reaffirms that the country’s operational sovereignty is subject to the White House’s directives,” Reyes said.
paras.zh: 雷耶斯说：“尼古拉斯·马杜罗被捕十个月后，华盛顿不再需要开枪提醒所有负责人：一月份入侵的策划者出现在委内瑞拉领土上，就再次证明了该国的行动主权受白宫指令的约束。”

paras.en: Reyes suspected the visit also carried a message for members of Venezuela’s armed forces. “Domestically, the trip forces the military high command to legitimize the man who directed the extraction of their former commander in chief,” she said. “In this regard, I wonder whether it might be a message of discipline intended to prevent any pockets of resistance in the barracks.”
paras.zh: 雷耶斯怀疑这次访问也向委内瑞拉武装部队成员传达了一个信息。 “在国内，这次访问迫使军方最高指挥部将指挥撤离前总司令的人合法化，”她说。 “在这方面，我想知道这是否可能是一种纪律信息，旨在防止军营中出现任何小规模抵抗。”

paras.en: Trump’s attempts to expand his Shield of the Americas anti-cartel coalition of Latin American governments suffered a major blow last month with the defeat of his far-right ally, Flávio Bolsonaro, in Brazil’s presidential election. The leftwing winner, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, has indicated his country will not join the initiative.
paras.zh: 上个月，随着他的极右翼盟友弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗在巴西总统选举中落败，特朗普扩大拉丁美洲各国政府组成的“美洲之盾”反卡特尔联盟的努力遭受重大打击。左翼获胜者路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦表示，他的国家不会加入该倡议。

paras.en: But Venezuela’s interim government is in little position to resist. During his surprise visit to Venezuela, Hegseth said Venezuela had gone from being “our most aggressive regional threat to [being] a compliant security partner”. He praised Rodríguez for working “closely, pragmatically, and diligently with the United States to stabilize Venezuela”. Hegseth claimed US and Venezuelan armed forces would work together to attack “narco-terrorists” operating on Venezuelan soil, vowing: “We will hunt you down. We will find you. And we will kill you.”
paras.zh: 但委内瑞拉临时政府无力抵抗。赫格斯塞斯在突然访问委内瑞拉期间表示，委内瑞拉已经从“我们最具侵略性的地区威胁，变成了一个顺从的安全伙伴”。他赞扬罗德里格斯“与美国密切、务实和勤奋地合作以稳定委内瑞拉局势”。赫格斯声称，美国和委内瑞拉武装部队将共同打击在委内瑞拉领土上活动的“毒品恐怖分子”，并发誓：“我们将追捕你。我们将找到你。我们将杀死你。”

paras.en: Concluding her speech at the palace, Rodríguez told her foe-turned-friend: “Thank you, secretary, and I wish you a lifetime of happiness.”
paras.zh: 在宫殿演讲结束时，罗德里格斯对她从敌人变成朋友的人说：“谢谢你，秘书，我祝你一生幸福。”

articles.title: Grand Theft Auto 6 is a masterpiece, say critics

paras.en: After 13 years of waiting, record-breaking trailers and lengthy delays, critics have given their answer to one of the year's biggest questions.
paras.zh: 经过 13 年的等待、破纪录的预告片和漫长的延迟，评论家们对今年最大的问题之一给出了答案。

paras.en: Does Grand Theft Auto 6, surely the most anticipated game of all time, live up to the hype?
paras.zh: 《侠盗猎车手 6》无疑是有史以来最受期待的游戏，它是否辜负了人们的宣传？

paras.en: According to the first reviews, it's a resounding yes.
paras.zh: 根据第一批评论，这是一个响亮的肯定。

paras.en: Metacritic, which aggregates reviews from critics, averages it at 99 out of 100, external - tying with Nintendo's The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time, which has held the record since 1998.
paras.zh: 汇总了评论家评论的 Metacritic 的平均评分为 99 分（满分 100 分），与任天堂的《塞尔达传说：时之笛》追平，后者自 1998 年以来一直保持着这一记录。

paras.en: Reviewers overwhelmingly agreed the open-world action game was an ambitious, ground-breaking title that was well worth the wait.
paras.zh: 评论家们一致认为这款开放世界动作游戏是一款雄心勃勃、具有开创性的游戏，非常值得等待。

paras.en: Not everyone is enjoying the glowing praise - with some posters to online forums objecting to what one called "the ultra fan-boy hype."
paras.zh: 并不是每个人都喜欢这种热烈的赞扬——在线论坛上的一些海报反对所谓的“超级粉丝炒作”。

paras.en: But there is no question the reviewers have been effusive with their praise, with gaming website IGN, external branding GTA 6 "unprecedented", "unbelievable" and "unmissable".
paras.zh: 但毫无疑问，评论家们对GTA 6赞不绝口，游戏网站IGN对外评价GTA 6“史无前例”、“难以置信”和“不容错过”。

paras.en: Meanwhile in its five star review, Eurogamer said makers Rockstar had "pushed back the horizon of video games once again" with its graphics, storytelling and world building.
paras.zh: 与此同时，Eurogamer 在其五星级评价中表示，开发商 Rockstar 凭借其图形、故事讲述和世界构建“再次推动了视频游戏的发展”。

paras.en: "The awe is all part of the point, of course, and GTA 6 is nothing if not truly awesome," reviewer Chris Tapsell wrote, external, but he added "there are also nits to pick".
paras.zh: 评论家 Chris Tapsell 在外部写道：“当然，敬畏是重点的一部分，《侠盗猎车手 6》如果不是真正的精彩，那就毫无意义。”但他补充说，“也有一些不足之处”。

paras.en: For The New York Times, external one of those nits was whether the realism of the game might dull the fun chaos of its predecessors.
paras.zh: 对于《纽约时报》来说，外部问题之一是游戏的真实性是否会削弱前作的有趣混乱。

paras.en: Reviewer Yussef Cole said GTA 6 had "matured beyond its memorable car crashes and stickups" with consequences to every action.
paras.zh: 评论家尤瑟夫·科尔 (Yussef Cole) 表示，GTA 6 已经“成熟，超越了令人难忘的车祸和抢劫”，对每一个动作都会产生影响。

paras.en: But "some of my favourite moments have been careening through streets with squad cars in hot pursuit," he wrote.
paras.zh: 但“我最喜欢的一些时刻是警车紧追不舍地穿过街道，”他写道。

paras.en: The graphics of the game were hotly anticipated and so far have not disappointed critics, with The Guardian, external describing Leonida, the setting inspired by Miami, as "so lifelike that at times it beggars belief".
paras.zh: 游戏的图像受到了热烈的期待，到目前为止也没有让评论家失望，《卫报》外部描述《列奥尼达》，灵感来自迈阿密的场景，“如此逼真，有时令人难以置信”。

paras.en: And the relationship between the lead characters, Jason and Lucia, has also stunned critics.
paras.zh: 而主角杰森和露西亚之间的关系也让评论家们大吃一惊。

paras.en: "They feel like real people rather than puppets dancing to your whim," The Guardian's Keza MacDonald wrote, adding: "I found it impossible not to care for them".
paras.zh: 《卫报》的凯扎·麦克唐纳写道：“他们感觉像是真人，而不是随你的心血来潮跳舞的木偶。”他补充道：“我发现不可能不关心他们”。

paras.en: Writing for Forbes, external, Paul Tassi said: "I can't say I've ever seen a better video game relationship than the one they share".
paras.zh: 保罗·塔西 (Paul Tassi) 在《福布斯》外部撰稿时表示：“我从来没有见过比他们之间的电子游戏关系更好的了”。

paras.en: The Washington Post, external said GTA 6 "raises the bar at every level", while Bloomberg, external's Jason Schreier called it a "masterpiece" in his five star review.
paras.zh: 《华盛顿邮报》外部称《GTA 6》“在各个层面都提高了标准”，而彭博社外部的杰森·施赖尔在他的五星级评论中称其为“杰作”。

paras.en: "It's hard not to be astonished by what Rockstar has done here," he wrote. "There's nothing else like it.
paras.zh: “很难不对 Rockstar 在这里所做的事情感到惊讶，”他写道。 “没有什么比这更好的了。

paras.en: "While playing this game, I often found myself wondering how it even exists."
paras.zh: “在玩这个游戏时，我常常想知道它是如何存在的。”

paras.en: Rockstar hasn't revealed the cost of the game, but some estimates put the figure north of $1bn (Â£760m).
paras.zh: Rockstar 尚未透露该游戏的成本，但一些估计数字超过 10 亿美元（7.6 亿英镑）。

paras.en: Gaming journalist Jordan Middler is one of the lucky few in the UK who got early access from Rockstar and tells BBC Newsbeat it is the "game of a generation".
paras.zh: 游戏记者 Jordan Middler 是英国少数抢先体验 Rockstar 的幸运儿之一，他告诉 BBC Newsbeat，这是“一代人的游戏”。

paras.en: He'd played for about 100 hours by the time he hit the credits and says he still has so much to do.
paras.zh: 当他看到制作人员名单时，他已经玩了大约 100 个小时，并表示他还有很多事情要做。

paras.en: Middler did spot one negative though - he found the game can "slow down" because of how much is going on.
paras.zh: 不过，米德尔确实发现了一个负面因素——他发现比赛可能会因为发生的事情而“放慢速度”。

paras.en: He also says it is "long overdue" that there is a female lead in Lucia.
paras.zh: 他还表示，《露西亚》“早就该”出现女性主角了。

paras.en: "The way previous GTA games have dealt with women has been a boys' club approach," he says.
paras.zh: “以前的 GTA 游戏对待女性的方式一直是男孩俱乐部的方式，”他说。

paras.en: "Introducing Lucia and not making her some kind of token character, she just fits in completely... and she will quickly become a fan favourite without question."
paras.zh: “介绍露西亚并不是让她成为某种象征性的角色，她只是完全融入......毫无疑问，她很快就会成为粉丝的最爱。”

paras.en: The Game Awards - the most watched ceremony of its kind in the industry - gave players a teaser of the critical reception when its 2026 nominations were revealed on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 游戏大奖是业内最受关注的同类颁奖典礼，周二公布 2026 年提名时，玩家们先睹为快。

paras.en: And despite having not released at the time, GTA 6 was the most-nominated title.
paras.zh: 尽管《GTA 6》当时尚未发行，但它已成为获得提名最多的游戏。

paras.en: It will be up for eight prizes, including game of the year and best music.
paras.zh: 该游戏将角逐八个奖项，包括年度游戏奖和最佳音乐奖。

paras.en: The nomination of Manni L Perez in the best performance category confirmed wide speculation that she is the actress behind main character Lucia in GTA 6 - a fact Rockstar hadn't previously officially confirmed.
paras.zh: 曼尼·L·佩雷斯 (Manni L Perez) 获得最佳表演奖提名，证实了人们对她是《侠盗猎车手 6》主角露西亚 (Lucia) 背后的女演员的广泛猜测，而 Rockstar 此前并未正式证实这一事实。

paras.en: The jury for the event is largely made up of gaming journalists around the world, who would have received advanced copies for review.
paras.zh: 该活动的评审团主要由世界各地的游戏记者组成，他们将收到预审副本。

paras.en: Some, though, have questioned how a game that has just been released has garnered such positive reviews and award nominations.
paras.zh: 不过，有些人质疑一款刚刚发布的游戏如何获得如此积极的评价和奖项提名。

paras.en: There is a view in some online forums that the hype around the game has got out of control as, with one poster commenting: "I think everyone's tired of hearing about this game - I don't even want to play it anymore."
paras.zh: 一些在线论坛上有一种观点认为，围绕这款游戏的炒作已经失控，一位发帖者评论道：“我认为每个人都厌倦了听到这款游戏 - 我什至不想再玩它了。”

paras.en: It appears so far, however, that is likely to be very much a minority view.
paras.zh: 然而，到目前为止，这很可能只是少数人的观点。

articles.title: William and Kate meet PM Modi as they wrap up India tour

paras.en: The Prince and Princess of Wales have met India's prime minister as they ended their three-day visit to the country.
paras.zh: 威尔士王子和王妃在结束对印度为期三天的访问时会见了印度总理。

paras.en: Narendra Modi thanked Prince William for bringing his Earthshot prize to the country during the couple's first international tour since 2022.
paras.zh: 纳伦德拉·莫迪感谢威廉王子在这对夫妇自 2022 年以来的首次国际巡演中将他的 Earthshot 奖带到了该国。

paras.en: It comes a day after the royal couple gave out Â£1m prizes to winners of the environmental award, which was founded by the prince and remains one of his biggest personal projects.
paras.zh: 一天前，这对王室夫妇向环境奖获奖者颁发了 100 万英镑的奖金，该奖项由王子创立，至今仍然是他最大的个人项目之一。

paras.en: Catherine also visited a maternity hospital, where she comforted a grieving mother who lost a baby after giving birth to premature twin girls.
paras.zh: 凯瑟琳还参观了一家妇产医院，在那里她安慰了一位在生下早产双胞胎女孩后失去婴儿的悲伤母亲。

paras.en: On Wednesday, William and Catherine travelled from Mumbai to capital New Delhi for the final leg of their trip.
paras.zh: 周三，威廉和凯瑟琳从孟买飞往首都新德里，开始旅程的最后一站。

paras.en: During a meeting at Modi's private residence, a Kensington Palace spokesperson said the royals and Modi discussed the "strength and importance of the UKâIndia bilateral relationship, reflecting on the deep and enduring ties between the two countries and the opportunities to strengthen their partnership in the years ahead".
paras.zh: 在莫迪私人官邸举行的一次会议上，肯辛顿宫发言人表示，王室成员和莫迪讨论了“英印双边关系的强度和重要性，反思了两国之间深厚而持久的关系以及未来几年加强伙伴关系的机会”。

paras.en: The prince and princess also spoke "warmly" of their time in the country, thanking the prime minister and the people for their welcome, and saying how much they enjoyed returning to India, a decade after their last visit.
paras.zh: 王子和公主还“热情”地谈到了他们在印度的时光，感谢总理和人民的欢迎，并表示他们非常高兴在上次访问印度十年后回到印度。

paras.en: Modi called it a "pleasure" to meet them, and said he looks forward to "further strengthening" the UKâIndia partnership for the "shared prosperity of the people of our nations and the wider world".
paras.zh: 莫迪称很高兴见到他们，并表示他期待“进一步加强”英印伙伴关系，以实现“我们两国人民和更广阔的世界的共同繁荣”。

paras.en: When Prince William announced earlier this year that The Earthshot Prize ceremony was going to be held in India for the first time, he highlighted India's leadership in climate innovation, its biodiversity and its massive youth population as the key reasons for choosing the country.
paras.zh: 当威廉王子今年早些时候宣布“地球射击奖”颁奖典礼将首次在印度举行时，他强调印度在气候创新、生物多样性和庞大的年轻人口方面的领导地位是选择印度的关键原因。

paras.en: The royal spokesperson said that the meeting with Modi touched on the success of the ceremony in Mumbai, and India's "growing leadership in environmental innovation".
paras.zh: 这位王室发言人表示，与莫迪的会面涉及孟买仪式的成功以及印度“在环境创新方面日益增长的领导力”。

paras.en: The event, founded by Prince William in 2020, was hosted this year by Karan Johar, presenter of The Traitors India and one of the country's most well-known filmmakers.
paras.zh: 该活动由威廉王子于 2020 年创办，今年由《印度叛徒》节目主持人、印度最著名的电影制片人之一卡兰·乔哈尔 (Karan Johar) 主持。

paras.en: The couple last met the Indian prime minister on their official visit to India in 2016.
paras.zh: 这对夫妇最后一次见到印度总理是在2016年对印度进行正式访问时。

paras.en: Ahead of their meeting with Modi on Wednesday, William met with film stars during a visit to a film production company, while Catherine visited a maternity hospital, where she met grieving mother Jyoti Karande.
paras.zh: 在周三与莫迪会面之前，威廉在参观一家电影制作公司时会见了电影明星，而凯瑟琳则参观了一家妇产医院，在那里她遇到了悲伤的母亲乔蒂·卡兰德。

paras.en: Karande, whose other child remains in intensive care, is receiving treatment in the post-partum ward at Nowrosjee Wadia Maternity Hospital.
paras.zh: 卡兰德的另一个孩子仍在重症监护室，目前正在诺罗斯吉瓦迪亚妇产医院的产后病房接受治疗。

paras.en: Catherine told the 29-year-old: "Stay strong. Well done. You've clearly been very, very brave."
paras.zh: 凯瑟琳告诉这位 29 岁的女孩：“保持坚强。干得好。你显然非常非常勇敢。”

paras.en: William and Catherine's first official overseas trip in four years was short, but allowed them to combine personal projects - like Earthshot - with diplomacy.
paras.zh: 威廉和凯瑟琳四年来的首次正式海外访问虽然短暂，但使他们能够将个人项目（例如“地球拍摄”）与外交结合起来。

paras.en: As the future king and queen, they are viewed as a valuable diplomatic asset by the UK government.
paras.zh: 作为未来的国王和王后，他们被英国政府视为宝贵的外交资产。

paras.en: And with Catherine recovering well and back on international duties following her cancer treatment, visits of a similar kind can be expected to fill their calendar.
paras.zh: 随着凯瑟琳在癌症治疗后恢复良好并重新履行国际职责，类似的访问预计会填满他们的日历。

articles.title: Israeli military launches rare ground operation in Gaza beyond Yellow Line

paras.en: Israeli ground forces have launched a rare operation in part of the central Gaza Strip outside their control, after issuing evacuation orders for residents.
paras.zh: 以色列地面部队在向居民发出疏散命令后，在其控制范围之外的加沙地带中部部分地区发起了罕见的行动。

paras.en: Witnesses said tanks advanced east of Nuseirat refugee camp and rolled onto the territory's main north to south road under the cover of artillery strikes.
paras.zh: 目击者称，坦克在炮火掩护下向努塞拉特难民营以东推进，驶上该领土从北向南的主要道路。

paras.en: The Israeli military said the "targeted" operation aimed to dismantle a "terror tunnel" west of the so-called Yellow Line, which marks the more than 60% of Gaza's territory occupied by Israel.
paras.zh: 以色列军方表示，这次“有针对性”行动的目的是拆除所谓黄线以西的一条“恐怖隧道”，黄线标志着加沙60%以上的领土被以色列占领。

paras.en: The Palestinian armed group Hamas, which controls the rest of Gaza, accused Israel of a "flagrant violation" of the October 2025 ceasefire agreement.
paras.zh: 控制加沙其他地区的巴勒斯坦武装组织哈马斯指责以色列“公然违反”2025年10月停火协议。

paras.en: Violence has continued in Gaza over the past 13 months, with near-daily Israeli strikes, and living conditions for the 2.1 million people there remain dire.
paras.zh: 过去 13 个月里，加沙的暴力事件持续不断，以色列几乎每天都会发动袭击，那里 210 万人的生活条件仍然十分悲惨。

paras.en: Early on Wednesday afternoon, Israeli military body Cogat's Arabic spokesperson announced the start of the incursion and warned Palestinians living in an area north of Nuseirat and Bureij refugee camp to stay away for their own safety.
paras.zh: 周三下午早些时候，以色列军事机构 Cogat 的阿拉伯语发言人宣布开始入侵，并警告居住在 Nuseirat 和 Bureij 难民营以北地区的巴勒斯坦人为了自身安全而远离。

paras.en: It also said a section of the north to south Salah al-Din road that passed through the area would be closed to traffic.
paras.zh: 它还表示，穿过该地区的从北到南的 Salah al-Din 公路的一段路段将封闭。

paras.en: Later, the Israel Defense Forces (IDF) said it had begun a joint operation with the Shin Bet security service "to dismantle a terror tunnel west of the Yellow Line that posed an immediate and direct threat to IDF troops".
paras.zh: 随后，以色列国防军（IDF）表示，已开始与辛贝特安全部门开展联合行动，“拆除黄线以西的一条恐怖隧道，该隧道对以色列国防军部队构成直接威胁”。

paras.en: "IDF troops under the Southern Command are deployed in the area in accordance with the ceasefire agreement and will continue to operate to remove any immediate threat and thwart attempts by the Hamas terrorist organisation to harm Israeli civilians or IDF troops, or to violate the agreement," it added.
paras.zh: 声明补充说：“南方司令部领导下的以色列国防军部队根据停火协议部署在该地区，并将继续采取行动消除任何直接威胁，并挫败哈马斯恐怖组织伤害以色列平民或以色列国防军部队或违反协议的企图。”

paras.en: Hamas warned in a statement that the advance of Israeli military vehicles beyond the Yellow Line and the evacuation of residents constituted "a dangerous development and a flagrant violation of the ceasefire agreement".
